ingredients_quantity: 225 grams Vivatta Maida  375 grams Dry Fruits , (Golden raisins, sultanas, candied peel, glaced cherries,dried cranberries,dried apricots etc)  2 teaspoons Baking powder  250 ml Tea , decoction (cold tea)  50 ml Whiskey , optional  125 grams Brown Sugar (Demerara Sugar)  1 Whole Egg  2 teaspoons All spice powder
instructions: To bgein making the Irish Barm Brack recipe, place the fruit mix in a bowl and pour over the whiskey (if using) and cold tea. Allow to soak up the liquid overnight.Preheat the oven to 170˚C/327°/Gas Mark 3 and grease and line a 900g loaf tin.Combine the flour, baking powder, sugar and mixed spice in a mixing bowl. Make a well and break in the egg, using a wooden spoon, mix the egg with the dry ingredients.Add a little bit of the tea liquid in the the fruit mix and mix it through. You may not need all the liquid, you are looking for a wet dough. Then stir through the fruit mix until everything is thoroughly combined.Graese a loaf tin and set it aside. Spoon the wet dough into the lined loaf tin and place in the oven on the middle shelf and bake for 1 hour. Remove from the oven and allow to cool slightly before removing from the loaf tin and placing on wire rack.Cover in cling wrap and tin foil and allow to sit for 1-2 days before cutting into it. Serve in slices.Serve Irish Barm Brack for a special occasion or serve it with Espresso Coffee and Chicken Sandwich With Sweet Corn for your next tea party.

name: Chettinad Sweet Paniyaram Recipe
description: Chettinad Sweet Paniyaram is a healthy, tasty south Indian snack recipe prepared with idli batter. This can also be had as breakfast or as festive recipe. It is prepared with idli batter, coconut and jaggery as main ingredients. Perfect to serve with that hot cup of tea.
ingredients_name: Idli Dosa Batter,Rice rava,Jaggery,Fresh coconut,Cardamom Powder (Elaichi),Salt,Water,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Idli Dosa Batter  4 tablespoons Rice rava  1/3 cup Jaggery  3 tablespoons Fresh coconut , grated  1 teaspoon Cardamom Powder (Elaichi) Salt , to taste Water , as required Oil , as required
instructions: To begin making the Chettinad Sweet Paniyaram recipe, take dosa batter in a mixing bowl, add rava, powdered jaggery, coconut, salt, cardamom powder to it.Add required water and mix well with a ladle into thick batter. Keep aside for 5 minutes and mix again.Add little water if required to adjust the consistency. Heat paniyaram pan and add oil to all holes.Once hot, pour batter into all the holes and cover cook with a lid in low flame.Once cooked, flip to the other side gently with a spoon and cook until golden.Remove from pan and arrange in a plate. Serve hot and enjoy.Serve Chettinad Sweet Paniyaram along with a hot cup of Filter coffee for your tea time break.

name: Carrot Pistachio Coconut Cake Recipe
description: Moist Carrot Cake with a perfect balance of cinnamon and crunchy pistachios and toasted coconut flakes. You can serve it as a desert, pack it for your kids lunch or just enjoy it with your afternoon cuppa. While carrots add moistness and sweetness to this cake, pistachios and coconut add wonderful texture making it wholesome and delicious. You can serve it with a scoop of ice cream, or just have it by itself.
ingredients_name: Carrots (Gajjar),Whole Eggs,Oil,Sugar,Vanilla Extract,Vivatta Maida,Baking soda,Baking powder,Salt,Pistachios,Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini),Fresh coconut
ingredients_quantity: 250 grams Carrots (Gajjar) , finely grated  4 Whole Eggs  240 ml Oil , or any flavorless oil  290 grams Sugar , granulated  2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract  250 grams Vivatta Maida  1 teaspoon Baking soda  1-1/2 teaspoons Baking powder  1/2 teaspoon Salt  40 grams Pistachios , roughly chopped  1-1/2 teaspoons Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini)  40 grams Fresh coconut , toasted and shredded
instructions: To begin making the Carrot Pistachio Coconut Cake recipe, preheat your oven at 180 degree C for 10 minutes.Prepare either two 9 inch round pans or one 10 inch bundt pan by coating with butter/oil and dusting with flour.Now peel and finely grate the carrots and keep them aside. Chop pistachios coarsely. Do not make them super fine.Slightly toast the shredded coconut over medium flame for about 2-3 minutes. Do not brown them. We just need to bring out crunchiness of coconut.With the help of hand mixer, beat all the 4 eggs until they are frothy.Slowly, add sugar and continue beating till the mixture doubles in volume and looks pale yellow (about 4 minutes).Now add oil in the above mixture and then beat in the vanilla extract. Mix it properly. Whisk together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, and ground cinnamon in a bowl.Add the flour mixture in the egg-sugar mixture and beat just until incorporated. Finally, fold in the grated carrots, chopped pistachios and toasted coconut gently in the above batter.If using 9 inch round pans, divide batter in the two pans equally and bake for 25-30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.If using bundt pan, the time to bake will increase to about 30-35 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool on a wire rackAfter about 5 to 10 minutes invert the cakes onto the wire rack and let it cool completely.Serve Carrot Pistachio Coconut Cake along with Espresso Coffee and Cucumber Sandwich with Yogurt and Dill Spread Recipe for your tea break.

name: Jodhpuri Kabuli Recipe
description: Jodhpuri Kabuli Recipe is a dish that is more nostalgic from the state of Rajasthan. The rice is mixed with various ingredients like fried vegetables, toasted bread cubes and toasted cashew nuts, raisins and finally with fresh pomegranate seeds. This rice has subtle flavors from cloves, cinnamon and cardamom pods. The addition of ghee while cooking helps to enhance the flavor of the rice to another level. The rice will form a one dish meal for your Sunday lunch as it is filled with lots of nutrients.
ingredients_name: Rice,Cloves (Laung),Lemon juice,Ghee,Fennel seeds (Saunf),Cumin seeds (Jeera),Black cardamom (Badi Elaichi),Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seeds,Whole Black Peppercorns,Onion,Cauliflower (gobi),Potato (Aloo),Green peas (Matar),Whole Wheat Brown Bread,Curd (Dahi / Yogurt),Fresh Pomegranate Fruit Kernels,Turmeric powder (Haldi),Red Chilli powder,Cashew nuts,Sultana Raisins,Ghee
ingredients_quantity: For the Rice 2 cups Rice , washed and soaked for 30 minutes    2 Cloves (Laung)  1 Lemon juice  1 teaspoon Ghee Whole Spice 1 teaspoon Fennel seeds (Saunf)  1 teaspoon Cumin seeds (Jeera)  1 Black cardamom (Badi Elaichi)  1 Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seeds  1 teaspoon Whole Black Peppercorns Other Ingredients   1 Onion , chopped  1/2 cup Cauliflower (gobi) , cut into small florets  1 Potato (Aloo) , skin peeled and chopped small  1/4 cup Green peas (Matar)  4 Whole Wheat Brown Bread , cut into cubes  1/2 cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt)  1/4 cup Fresh Pomegranate Fruit Kernels  1 teaspoon Turmeric powder (Haldi)  2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder  2 tablespoon Cashew nuts  2 tablespoon Sultana Raisins Ghee , for cooking
instructions: To begin making the Jodhpuri Kabuli Recipe, first keep the rice in a pressure cooker with ghee, cloves and lemon juice. Add about 4 cups of water and pressure cook for 2 whistle.In the meanwhile, heat a kadai with 2 tablespoon ghee, add bread cubes and toast them till they are light brown and toasty. Keep it aside.Into the same kadai add some more ghee and toast the cashew nuts and raisins and keep them aside.Add little more and all the whole spice and allow it sizzle for few seconds. Add onions and saute till they turn translucent.Add cauliflower, potato and sprinkle with little salt and turmeric. Allow it to cook for few minutes. You can sprinkle with water and cover it with the lid and cook for at least 10 minutes until done.Add all the spice powders along with curd and keep stirring till the water evaporates from the curd.Once that is done add green peas and toasted bread cubes and give it a stir. Add cooked rice as well. Give a stir and check for salt.Switch off the heat, serve it in a bowl and sprinkle with toasted cashew nuts, raisins and pomegranates on top. Serve the Jodhpuri Kabuli Recipe along with raita by the side and Dill Poha Cutlets to begin with for your Sunday lunch.

name: Healthy Lemon Cupcakes Recipe (Eggless)
description: If you like lemon juice, then definitely you would love the taste of this cupcakes, as its exactly the same taste! Also its healthy as I'm using whole wheat flour and eggless too. You can make these delicious cupcakes for your tea parties or even for your kids birthday parties.
ingredients_name: Whole Wheat Flour,Water,Caster Sugar,Lemon juice,Oil,Turmeric powder (Haldi),Baking powder,Baking soda,Sultana Raisins
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Whole Wheat Flour  1 cup Water  1 cup Caster Sugar  1 tablespoon Lemon juice  1 tablespoon Oil Turmeric powder (Haldi) , a pinch  1/2 teaspoon Baking powder  1/4 teaspoon Baking soda Sultana Raisins , black for garnishing
instructions: To bgein making the Healthy Lemon Cupcakes recipe, firstly start preheating your microwave at 180 degrees.In a medium sized bowl, add water, castor sugar, turmeric powder and lemon juice and mix it well. Now, in another bowl, seive whole wheat flour, baking powder and baking soda all together.Gradually add flour mixture in two batches into water micture and stir until just combined. Set cupcake liners into cupcake mould and pour the batter into them.Bake them into preheated oven for 18-20 minutes. Its ready to serve!Serve Healthy Lemon Cupcakes along with Masala Chai for your tea time break or pack them in your kids snack box for a weekday treat.

name: Buckwheat Apple Cinnamon Loaf Cake Recipe
description: Rich in protein, fibre and nutrients, munch on these cakes guilt free. Healthy, rich in aroma and blend of right flavors makes this cake perfect for snacking any time of the day. Enjoy every bite of this yummilicious cake. You can also make this cake for your tea parties or pot luck parties.
ingredients_name: Buckwheat Flour (Kuttu Ka Atta),Corn flour,Brown Sugar (Demerara Sugar),Apple,Baking powder,Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini),Vanilla Extract,Butter (Salted),Icing Sugar,Milk
ingredients_quantity: 11/4 cup Buckwheat Flour (Kuttu Ka Atta)  5 tablespoon Corn flour  1/2 cup Brown Sugar (Demerara Sugar) , (alternatively icing sugar)  1 Apple , peeled, cored and cubed  1-1/2 teaspoon Baking powder  1-1/2 teaspoon Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini)  1-1/2 teaspoon Vanilla Extract  100 gram Butter (Salted) , soft low fat  2/3 cup Icing Sugar  1/2 cup Milk , low fat
instructions: To begin making the Buckwheat Apple Cinnamon Loaf Cake recipe, sieve all dry ingredients and keep it aside.Preheat the oven to 180. Mix brown sugar, cinnamon and keep it aside.In a bowl, add butter and sugar and blend it until creamy. Add eggs, 1 at a time and blend until pale yellow in colour. Add vanilla extract and mix. Now add dry ingredients and milk alternately. Using cut and fold method mix well.Pour the half batter in greased loaf pan, add half of apples evenly all over. Sprinkle half of cinnamon sugar on top of apple. Now pour remaining batter and add rest of apple on top. Sprinkle remaining Cinnamon sugar on top.Bake for 25 to 40 minute until done. Once it is done, allow it to cool completely. Cut and serve these delicious cakes.Serve Buckwheat Apple Cinnamon Loaf Cake along with Espresso Coffee and Shredded Chicken Cheese Sandwich for your tea party.

name: Amritsari Ajwaini Paneer Recipe – Amritsari Ajwaini Paneer (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Amritsari Ajwaini Paneer is a delicious recipe from North India which is flavored with spices and ajwain. Cashews are also used in it which further enhances its taste. You can also make this dish for your guests.
ingredients_name: Paneer,Tomato Puree,Onion,Garlic,Green Chilli,Ginger,Cashew,Cloves,Carom Seeds,Garam Masala Powder,Turmeric Powder,Coriander Powder,Red Chili Powder,Sugar,Salt,Oil,Coriander Leaves
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup paneer 1 cup tomato puree 1 onion, finely chopped 2 cloves garlic 1 green chilli 1 inch ginger 5 cashews 2 cloves 1 teaspoon celery 1 teaspoon garam masala powder 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1-1/2 teaspoon coriander powder 1/2 teaspoon red chilli powder 1/2 teaspoon sugar Salt 1 tablespoon oil Coriander leaves, chopped, for garnish
instructions: To make Amritsari Ajwaini Paneer, first put onion, garlic, ginger and green chillies in a mixer grinder and make a paste. Keep it aside. Now add cashew nuts along with some water in a mixer grinder and make a paste. Keep it aside. Now put celery and cloves in a mortar and grind it. Heat oil in a pan. Add onion paste in it and cook it for 3 minutes. Now add turmeric powder, ground masala and garam masala and cook it for 2 minutes. Now add tomato puree, coriander powder, red chilli powder and salt in it. Cover the pan and cook for 4 to 5 minutes. After this add cashew paste, sugar and cook for 1 minute. Now add paneer in it, mix it and garnish with green coriander. Serve Amritsari Ajwaini Paneer with Onion Thepla and Coriander Mint Chutney.

name: Lauki Chana Dal Recipe (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Lauki Chana Dal is a healthy recipe in which lauki is cooked with lentils and spices. Lauki is also called dudhi and is used in everyday food in every household. It is prepared differently in different states and the taste is also different.
ingredients_name: Bottle Gourd,Chana Dal,Cumin,Bay Leaf,Ginger,Tomato,Coriander Powder,Turmeric Powder,Red Chili Powder,Sugar,Coriander Leaves,Oil,Cumin,Dried Red Chilli,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 gourd, peeled and chopped 1 cup chana dal 1 tsp cumin seeds 1 bay leaf 1 tsp ginger, grated 1 tomato, finely chopped 1 tsp coriander powder 1/4 tsp turmeric powder 1/2 tsp red chilli powder, to taste 1 tsp sugar 1 coriander leaf, a few, chopped 1 tsp oil for tempering 1 tsp cumin seeds 2 dried red chillies Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Lauki Chana Dal, first soak the chana dal in 1-1/2 cups of water for 1 hour. Now put chopped bottle gourd, 1/4 cup water, salt and turmeric powder in a pressure cooker. Cook till 2 whistles. Let the pressure release and keep it aside. Now put chana dal and remaining ingredients in the same pressure cooker and cook till 2 whistles. After 2 whistles, reduce the flame and let it cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Let the pressure release and keep it aside. Open the cooker and add bottle gourd in it. Now add tempering to it. Heat oil in a small pan. Add cumin seeds, red chili powder and dry red chilies in it. Turn off the gas after 15 seconds and put it in the dal. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve. Serve Lauki Chana Dal with Boondi Raita and Phulkas for lunch.

name: Aloo Dum - Aloo Dum (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Aloo Dum, also known as Dum Aloo, is a spicy and sour recipe that you can make for your everyday meal. Dum means cooking anything on low flame. You can also make this dish for your weekend morning breakfast.
ingredients_name: Potato,Turmeric Powder,Cardamom,Cinnamon,Cloves,Bay Leaf,Tomato,Yogurt,Garam Masala Powder,Red Chili,Coriander Powder,Sugar,Salt,Oil,Coriander Leaves,Onion,Ginger,Garlic,Green Chilli
ingredients_quantity: 10 potatoes 2 tsp turmeric powder 2 cardamoms 1 inch cinnamon 2 cloves 1 bay leaf 3 tomatoes, puree 1/2 cup curd 1 tsp garam masala powder 1 tsp red chilli powder 1 tsp coriander powder 1 tsp sugar Salt, to taste Oil, as needed Coriander leaves, finely chopped for making paste 1 onion, chopped 1 inch ginger, chopped 3 cloves garlic 2 green chillies, chopped
instructions: To make Aloo Dum, first of all put onion, ginger, green chilli and garlic in a mixer grinder. Grind it and keep aside. Heat oil in a pan. Add boiled potatoes, turmeric powder, salt and cook till potatoes turn golden brown. Keep aside. In the same pan add 2 tbsp oil. Add onion, ginger and garlic paste. Let it cook for 4 to 5 minutes. After 5 minutes add cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and bay leaves. Let it cook for 2 minutes. Now add 1 cup tomato puree, turmeric powder, coriander powder and garam masala powder. Mix everything well. After this add curd, mix and mix well. After 1 minute add sugar, salt and potatoes. Cover the pan and cook for 3 minutes. After cooking, turn off the gas and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve Aloo Dum with Boondi Raita and Puri for breakfast.

name: Batata Nu Shaak Recipe – Batata Nu Shaak (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Batata nu shaak is a simple and delicious recipe that is made in every Gujarati household. In this dish, potatoes are cooked in a sour and spicy tomato gravy. You can make it for your everyday meal.
ingredients_name: Potato,Ginger,Tomato Puree,Cumin,Mustard Seeds,Turmeric Powder,Asafoetida,Red Chili Powder,Coriander Powder,Oil,Coriander Leaves,Black Salt,Salt,Black Salt (Kala Namak),Salt
ingredients_quantity: 4 potatoes, peeled and chopped 1 inch ginger, grated 2 tomatoes puree 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida 1 teaspoon red chilli powder 1 teaspoon coriander powder 2 teaspoons oil 1 coriander leaf, finely chopped Black salt or rock salt, to taste Salt, to taste Black Salt (Kala Namak), to taste Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Batata Nu Shaak, first heat oil in a wok. Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, cinnamon and let it cook for 30 seconds. Add asafoetida, turmeric powder, red chili powder, ginger, tomato puree and let it cook for 2 minutes. Now add coriander powder, garam masala powder, potatoes, salt, black salt and 2 cups of water. Let it boil and then cover the wok. Let it cook for 15 minutes or until the potatoes become soft. After cooking, mash some potatoes so that the gravy becomes a little thick. After preparation, garnish it with coriander leaves and serve. Serve Batata Nu Shaak with Boondi Raita and Puri for lunch.

name: Lauki Tamatar Ki Sabzi Recipe (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Lauki Tomato Sabzi is a healthy and simple recipe in which bottle gourd is cooked with tomatoes and spices. Simple everyday ingredients are used in it. You can make this vegetable for your everyday meal.
ingredients_name: Bottle Gourd,Onion,Garlic,Tomato,Cumin,Turmeric Powder,Red Chili Powder,Curry Leaves,Coriander Leaves,Oil,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 gourd, peeled and chopped 1 onion, finely chopped 3 garlic cloves, grated 1 tomato, finely chopped 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1/2 teaspoon red chilli powder 1 sprig curry leaves 1 coriander leaf, finely chopped Oil, as per use Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Lauki Tomato Sabzi, first heat oil in a pressure cooker. Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, onion, garlic and tomatoes. Cook for 2 minutes. Now add turmeric powder, red chili powder, curry leaves, salt and bottle gourd. Add 1/4 cup water and cook till 3 whistles. After 3 whistles, open the cooker and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve hot. Serve Lauki Tomato Sabzi with Burani Raita and Tawa Paratha for dinner.

name: Aloo Baingan Ki Sabzi Recipe - Aloo Baingan Ki Sabzi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Aloo Baingan ki Sabzi is made in every household of India but different spices are used in different states. This sabzi is very easy to make and can be prepared in very less time. In Gujarati it is also called Ringna Batata Nu Shak.
ingredients_name: Eggplant,Potato,Nigella Seeds,Ginger,Cumin,Tomato Puree,Turmeric Powder,Asafoetida,Red Chili Powder,Coriander Powder,Garam Masala Powder,Sugar,Coriander Leaves,Oil,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 3 cups brinjal, chopped 1 cup potatoes, peeled and chopped 1/2 teaspoon nigella seeds 1 teaspoon ginger, chopped 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds 1/2 cup tomato puree 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder 1/2 teaspoon asafoetida 1 teaspoon red chilli powder 1 teaspoon coriander powder 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder 1/2 teaspoon sugar 2 tablespoons coriander leaves, chopped 2 teaspoons oil Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Aloo Baingan ki Sabzi, first heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds, nigella seeds and let it cook for 15 seconds. Now add ginger, tomatoes, turmeric powder, asafoetida, red chili powder, garam masala powder and cook till tomatoes become soft. Add potatoes, brinjal, salt and 2 cups of water. Reduce the flame and cover the pan. Let the vegetables cook till they become soft. Keep stirring at times. Turn off the gas after cooking and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve. Serve Aloo Baingan ki Sabzi with Gujarati Kadhi and Methi Thepla for lunch.

name: Matar Paneer Recipe – Matar Paneer (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Matar paneer is a famous dish of North India in which paneer, peas and tomatoes are used. If you are not able to get fresh peas, you can also use frozen peas. Due to the presence of paneer in it, the amount of protein is high and it is also good for your children.
ingredients_name: Paneer,Green Peas,Tomato Puree,Onion,Ginger,Garlic,Turmeric Powder,Cumin Powder,Garam Masala Powder,Red Chili Powder,Oil,Salt,Coriander Leaves
ingredients_quantity: 250 grams paneer, chopped 1/2 cup green peas, steamed 2 cups tomato puree 1 onion, chopped 1 inch ginger, grated 2 cloves garlic 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder 1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder 1/2 teaspoon red chilli powder 1 tablespoon oil Salt, to taste Coriander leaves, a few, finely chopped
instructions: To make matar paneer, first cut the paneer in square pieces. Now put onion, ginger and garlic in a mixer grinder and make a paste. Keep it aside. Steam the peas and keep it aside. Now heat oil in a pan. Add onion mixture in it and cook till it turns golden. After it turns golden, add tomato puree, turmeric powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, salt and red chili powder. Mix well. Let it cook for 3 to 5 minutes. Add water as per requirement and mix it. Add paneer pieces and peas and cook for another 5 minutes. Turn off the gas and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve matar paneer with dal fry and tawa paratha for lunch.

name: Kerala Avial Recipe – Kerala Avial (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Aviyal is a traditional Kerala recipe in which vegetables are cooked with coconut. Coconut oil is used in it which adds more flavour to it. It is a healthy recipe and can be prepared in very less time.
ingredients_name: Ash Gourd,Drumstick,Carrot,Green Beans,Raw Banana,Potato,Yam,Coconut,Green Chilli,Curry Leaves,Cumin,Coconut Oil,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 250 gram ash gourd, sliced ​​lengthwise 2 drumsticks, sliced ​​lengthwise 2 carrots, sliced ​​lengthwise 10 green beans, sliced ​​lengthwise 1 raw banana, peeled and sliced ​​lengthwise 2 potatoes, peeled and sliced ​​lengthwise 250 gram sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced ​​For Coconut Gravy 1-1/2 cups coconut, grated 3 green chillies 1 sprig curry leaves 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 1 tablespoon coconut oil Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Kerala Aviyal, first steam all the vegetables with salt. Put all the vegetables in a pressure cooker. Add salt, 1/4 cup water and cook till 2 whistles. After 2 whistles, reduce the flame and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Place it under cold water and let the pressure release. Keep it aside. Now in a mixer grinder put coconut, green chillies, cumin seeds, curry leaves. Add some hot water and make a paste. Add this coconut mixture to the steamed vegetables. Add 1 tsp coconut oil, salt and mix it. Serve. Serve Kerala Aviyal with Keerai Sambar and Rice for lunch.

name: Palak Paneer Recipe – Palak Paneer (Recipe In Hindi)
description: In the Palak Paneer ki Sabzi, spinach is steamed and pureed, then cooked with everyday spices and finally paneer is added. Rich in nutrition, this sabzi is loved by everyone in the house.
ingredients_name: Paneer,Spinach,Tomato,Garlic,Ginger,Green Chilli,Cumin,Cinnamon Powder,Cumin Powder,Turmeric Powder,Garam Masala Powder,Cream,Butter,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 250 grams paneer, chopped 500 grams spinach, washed and chopped 1 tomato, pureed 2 cloves garlic, grated 2 inches ginger, grated 2 green chillies, chopped 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon powder 1 teaspoon cumin powder 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder 1 teaspoon garam masala powder 2 tablespoons cream 1 tablespoon butter Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Palak Paneer, first wash and chop the spinach. Steam the spinach for 4 to 5 minutes and keep it aside. After the spinach cools down, put it in a blender and make a puree. Now heat butter in a pan. Add cumin seeds, ginger, garlic and green chillies in it. After 15 seconds add tomatoes, turmeric powder and cook till tomatoes become soft. Now add spinach puree, cumin powder, garam masala powder, cinnamon powder and salt. Let it cook for 5 minutes. Finally add cream and paneer and mix. Serve hot. Serve Palak Paneer with Amritsari Dal and Mint Tawa Paratha for lunch.

name: Healthy Methi Matar Malai Recipe - Methi Matar Malai (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Mostly cashews and cream are used in methi malai matar but here we will use hung curd which will make this recipe tasty and healthy. Since this is a healthy recipe, you can make it for your daily meal.
ingredients_name: Fenugreek,Green Peas,Salt,Cumin,Tomato,Hung Yogurt,Sugar,Garam Masala Powder,Turmeric Powder,Black Pepper Powder,Onion,Green Chilli,Garlic,Ginger,Almond,Poppy Seeds
ingredients_quantity: 250 grams fenugreek, finely chopped 100 grams green peas, steamed Salt, according to taste 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds 1 tomato, pureed 1/2 cup hung curd 1/2 teaspoon sugar 1 teaspoon garam masala powder 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1/2 teaspoon black pepper powder For making the paste 1 onion, chopped 2 green chillies 2 cloves garlic 1 inch ginger 6 almonds 1 teaspoon poppy seeds
instructions: To make Methi Malai Matar, first take the given ingredients in a mixer grinder and grind them to make a paste. Now heat oil in a pan. Add fenugreek and salt. Cook till fenugreek becomes soft. After it becomes soft, take it out from the pan and keep it aside. Add some more oil in the same pan. Add the ground masala, salt and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. After that add turmeric powder, garam masala powder, black pepper powder and tomatoes. Mix it and let it cook for 1 minute. After 1 minute add hung curd and mix it. After 30 seconds add fenugreek and peas. Reduce the flame and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Turn off the gas and serve hot. Serve Methi Malai Matar with Tomato Onion Cucumber Raita, Panchmel Dal and Phulkas for lunch.

name: साग टोफू रेसिपी - Saag Tofu (Recipe In Hindi)
description: साग टोफू एक पारम्परिक रेसिपी है जिसे बिलकुल साग पनीर की तरह बनाया जाता है. इसमें सरसों और पालक का प्रयोग किया जाता है जो इस डिश को बहुत अच्छा फ्लेवर देता है. आप इस सब्ज़ी को अपनी हाउस पार्टीज के लिए भी बना सालते है. इस ताज़ी और स्वाद से भरपूर सब्ज़ी का सर्दियों में आनंद ले.
ingredients_name: Tofu,Spinach,Mustard Seeds,Ginger,Green Chilli,Tomato Puree,Garlic,Cumin,Asafoetida,Turmeric Powder,Garam Masala Powder,Salt,Corn Flour,Dried Red Chilli,Oil,Ghee,Water
ingredients_quantity: 250 ग्राम टोफू , काट ले  300 ग्राम पालक  300 ग्राम सरसों  2 इंच अदरक  4 हरी मिर्च , काट ले  1/4 कप टमाटर प्यूरी  8 लहसुन , पीस ले  1 छोटा चमच्च जीरा हींग , चुटकी भर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर  1 छोटा चमच्च गरम मसाला पाउडर नमक , स्वाद अनुसार  2 बड़े चमच्च मक्की का आटा  3 सुखी लाल मिर्च  1 छोटा चमच्च तेल  1 छोटा चमच्च घी पानी , प्रयोग अनुसार
instructions: साग टोफू बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले सरसों और पालक को धो ले. दोनों को काट कर 5 मिनट के लिए स्टीम कर ले. इसके बाद दोनों को थोड़ा ठंडा होने दे. ठंडा होने के बाद एक ब्लेंडर में डाले और प्यूरी बना ले. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें टोफू के टुकड़े डाले और हल्का भूरा होने तक पका ले. पकने के बाद अलग से निकाल ले. उसी कढ़ाई में घी गरम करें। इसमें सुखी लाल मिर्च, जीरा डाले और 15 सेकण्ड्स तक पकने दे. 15 सेकण्ड्स के बाद इसमें हींग, लहसुन, हरी मिर्च डाले और 1 मिनट तक पकने दे. 1 मिनट के बाद इसमें टमाटर प्यूरी, हल्दी पाउडर, गरम मसाला पाउडर डाले और उबाला आने दे. उबाला आने के बाद इसमें पालक और सरसों की प्यूरी और मक्के का आटा डाले। नमक डाले और 5 मिनट तक पकने दे. 5 मिनट के बाद गैस बंद करें और परोसे. साग टोफू को मक्की की रोटी और बुरानी रायते के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे.

name: Paneer Kalimirch Recipe - Paneer Kalimirch (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Paneer Kalimirch is a delicious, creamy paneer recipe made with black pepper and garlic. You can make this dish for your guests or pack it in your lunch box.
ingredients_name: Paneer,Cream,Milk,Turmeric Powder,Garam Masala Powder,Whole Black Pepper,Salt,Oil,Onion,Cashew,Garlic,Ginger,Garlic,Oil,Black Pepper Powder
ingredients_quantity: 250 grams paneer 1/4 cup cream 2 tablespoons milk 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder 1 teaspoon garam masala powder 2 teaspoons whole black pepper, grinded Salt, to taste Oil, as per requirement Ingredients to make the paste 1 onion, chopped 1/4 cup cashews 4 cloves garlic 1 inch ginger, peeled and chopped For garnish 4 cloves garlic, finely chopped 2 tablespoons oil Black pepper powder, a pinch
instructions: To make Paneer Kalimirch, first put onion, cashews, garlic, ginger in a mixer grinder and make a paste. Keep it aside. Cut the paneer into pieces. Heat one spoon oil on a pan and put paneer pieces on it. Cook till it turns golden from both the sides and keep it aside. Now heat oil in a pan. Put onion mixture in it and let it cook for 2 minutes. After this add cream and milk to it. Mix it. Add salt, turmeric powder, garam masala powder and let it cook for 3 minutes. Add some water and cook for 1 more minute. Now add black pepper and paneer to it. Mix it and let it cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Turn off the gas and take it out in a bowl. Now heat oil in a tempering pan. Add garlic to it and cook till it turns golden. Pour this tempering in a bowl and sprinkle some black pepper on top. Serve. Serve Paneer Kalimirch along with Palak Raita and Tawa Paratha for dinner.

name: लहसुनि छोले और पालक करी रेसिपी - Garlic Chickpeas And Spinach Curry (Recipe In Hindi)
description: लहसुनि छोले और पालक करी एक मिडिल ईस्टर्न करी है जो स्वाद से भरपूर है. आप इसमें फ्राइड एग डालकर नाश्ते के लिए खा सकते है. यह एक वेगन रेसिपी है जो प्रोटीन से भरपूर है.
ingredients_name: Chickpeas,Spinach,Onion,Tomato,Garlic,Olive Oil,Cumin Powder,Paprika Powder,Turmeric Powder,Garam Masala Powder,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 कप काबुली चना या छोला  1 कप पालक  1 प्याज , पतला काट ले  2 टमाटर , पतला काट ले  12 कली लहसुन  1 बड़ा चमच्च ओलिव का तेल  1 छोटा चमच्च जीरा पाउडर  1 छोटा चमच्च पैपरिका पाउडर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर गरम मसाला पाउडर , चुटकी भर नमक , स्वाद अनुसार
instructions: लहसुनि छोले और पालक करी बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले छोले को धो कर 8 घंटे के लिए भिगो दे. पानी निकाल ले और छोले को प्रेशर कुकर में डाल दे. इसमें 4 कप पानी, हल्दी पाउडर, नमक डाले और 1 सिटी आने तक पका ले. आंच धीमा करें और 15 मिनट तक पकने दे. अब कुकर बंद करें और प्रेशर निकलने दे. पालक को धो ले और 2 या 3 टुकड़े कर ले. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें प्याज डाले और प्याज के नरम होने तक पकाए. अब इसमें टमाटर, पालक डाले और उनके नरम होने तक पकाए। अब इसमें छोले और पानी डाले और 2 मिनट तक पकने दे. अब इसमें गरम मसाला डाले और मिला ले. ढके और 10 मिनट तक ढाका ही रहने दे. गरमा गरम परोसे. लहसुनि छोले और पालक करी को आप बूंदी रायता और पूरी के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे.

name: South Indian Style Vegetable Kurma Recipe - Vegetable Kurma (Recipe In Hindi)
description: South Indian style vegetable kurma is a delicious recipe in which many vegetables are used. Cashews and coconut paste is used in it which enhances its taste. You can also make it for your daily lunch.
ingredients_name: Basil Seeds,Onion,Tomato,Green Chilli,Red Chili Powder,Coriander Powder,Turmeric Powder,Black Pepper Powder,Salt,Cinnamon,Cardamom,Cloves,Ginger Garlic Paste,Coconut,Poppy Seeds,Cashew,Oil,Salt,Coriander Leaves
ingredients_quantity: 2 cups vegetables, carrots, beans, green peas, potatoes and cauliflower 2 onions 2 tomatoes, pureed 2 green chillies 1 tbsp red chilli powder 1-1/2 tbsp coriander powder 1 tsp turmeric powder 1 tsp black pepper powder Salt, to taste 2 inch cinnamon stick 3 cardamoms 4 cloves 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste 4 tbsp coconut, grated 2 tbsp poppy seeds 15 cashews 2 tbsp oil Salt, to taste Coriander leaves, a little (for garnish)
instructions: To make South Indian Style Vegetable Kurma, first wash and chop all the vegetables. Now put them in a pressure cooker with water and salt and cook till 2 whistles. Keep the pan under cold water to drain out the water. Keep it aside. Now put onion and tomato in a mixer grinder and make a paste of it. Soak cashew nuts in water for 30 minutes. After that put it in a mixer with poppy seeds and some water and grind it. Make a paste of coconut as well and keep it aside. Now heat oil in a pan. Add cinnamon, cardamom and cloves in it. After 15 seconds add onion and green chillies. Cook till the onion becomes soft. Now add ginger garlic paste and cook for 1 minute. Now add tomato puree and let it cook for 3 minutes. Now add all the spices and mix it. Now add vegetables, salt and water and let it cook for 5 minutes. Add coconut poppy seeds paste to it, mix and turn off the gas. Serve. Serve South Indian Style Vegetable Kurma with Beetroot Pachadi and Laccha Paratha for dinner.

name: Puli Keerai Recipe – Puli Keerai (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Puli Kirai is a traditional recipe made in every household in South India. It is like a vegetable sambar which is served with rice. You can also pack it in your lunch box.
ingredients_name: Tamarind,Spinach,Sugar,Green Chilli,Salt,Oil,Mustard Seeds,Chana Dal,Curry Leaves,Dried Red Chilli
ingredients_quantity: Tamarind, a little 200 grams spinach Sugar, a pinch 4 green chillies Salt, as needed For tempering 1 teaspoon oil 1/2 teaspoon mustard 1/2 teaspoon gram dal 2 sprigs curry leaves 2 dried red chillies
instructions: To make Puli Kirai, first clean the spinach and wash it thoroughly. Now take a pressure cooker and put spinach, green chilies, salt, sugar and mix it. Add tamarind and some water to it. Cook till 1 whistle comes. Release the pressure and keep the spinach aside. Put the spinach mixture in a blender and grind it. Take it out in a bowl. Now heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and let it cook for 10 seconds. After that add chana dal and cook till it becomes light brown. Pour this tempering to the spinach mixture and mix it. Serve. Serve Puli Kirai with Beetroot Thoran and Rice for lunch.

name: Lauki Yakhini Recipe – Lauki Yakhini (Recipe In Hindi)
description: In Lauki Yakhni, gourd is cooked with curd and spices. This is a Kashmiri dish in which garlic and onion are not used. Cardamom and cloves are used in it which enhance its taste. You can also make this vegetable with bitter gourd or cabbage.
ingredients_name: Bottle Gourd,Cinnamon,Cardamom,Cloves,Carom Seeds,Ginger Powder,Fennel Powder,Asafoetida,Yogurt,Mustard Oil,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 bottle gourd 1 inch cinnamon 2 cardamom 3 cloves 1/2 teaspoon celery 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder 1 teaspoon fennel powder 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida 1 cup curd 1-1/2 tablespoons mustard oil Salt, according to taste
instructions: To make Lauki Yakhni, first cut the bottle gourd into small pieces. Now heat oil on a pan. Add bottle gourd on it and cook till it becomes light brown. Keep it aside. Now heat oil in a pan. Add cloves, cinnamon, celery and cook for 30 seconds. Reduce the flame and add water to it. After the water boils, add bottle gourd, ginger powder, fennel powder, asafoetida and mix it well. Now add curd and mix it. Let it cook for 3 to 5 minutes. Keep mixing. Add salt and cook for next 2 minutes. After 2 minutes add coriander leaves, garnish and serve. Serve Lauki Yakhni with Dal Fry, Kachumber Salad and Phulkas for lunch.

name: Cabbage Besan Fry Recipe – Cabbage Besan Fry (Recipe In Hindi)
description: If you are bored with the everyday cabbage dish, then definitely try this cabbage gram flour fry. In this recipe, cabbage is cooked with gram flour and spices. You can also eat it as a snack with evening tea.
ingredients_name: Cabbage,Besan,Ginger Garlic Paste,Red Chili Powder,Coriander Leaves,Salt,Oil,Water
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup cabbage 3 tbsp gram flour 1/2 tsp ginger garlic paste 1 tsp red chilli powder 3 sprigs coriander leaves, chopped Salt, to taste 2 tbsp oil 3 tbsp water
instructions: To make Cabbage Gram Flour Fry, first chop the cabbage and keep it aside. Now add salt, red chili powder and ginger garlic paste in it. Mix everything well. Now add gram flour and coriander leaves and mix it. Add some water so that the cabbage dissolves well. Now heat oil in a pan. Add cabbage mixture in it and let it cook for 2 minutes. Now cover the pan and cook for another 2 minutes. After 2 minutes, remove the lid of the pan and cook for another 2 minutes. Serve. Serve Cabbage Gram Flour Fry with Garlic Daal and Phulkas for lunch.

name: Bengali Phool Gobhir Paturi Recipe – Bengali Phool Gobhir Paturi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Bengali Cauliflower Paturi is a Bengali side dish in which cauliflower and potatoes are cooked with poppy seeds and cumin seeds. This dish is easy to make and gets ready in very less time. Adding poppy seeds enhances its taste even more.
ingredients_name: Potato,Cauliflower,Cumin,Poppy Seeds,Turmeric Powder,Green Chilli,Oil,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup potatoes, chopped 2 cups cabbage, chopped 1 tablespoon cumin seeds, black 3 tablespoons poppy seeds 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder 4 green chillies, according to taste 1 tablespoon oil 1/2 teaspoon salt
instructions: To make Bengali Cauliflower Paturi, first wash and chop potatoes and cauliflower. Now put water in a saucepan and let it boil. After water boils, add cauliflower and cook till it becomes soft. Drain the water and keep the cauliflower aside. Now heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let it cook for 30 seconds. Now add cauliflower, potatoes, turmeric powder, salt and mix them. Cover the pan and cook till the vegetables are cooked. Keep stirring at times. In the meantime, mix poppy seeds in a cup of water and keep it aside for 5 minutes. After this, drain the water and grind it in a mixer grinder along with green chillies. Pour this mixture into the pan. Mix and let it cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Turn off the gas and serve. Serve Bengali Cauliflower Paturi with Cholar Daal and Bengali Luchchi for dinner.

name: चेटिनाड बीन्स और गोभी पोरियल रेसिपी - Chettinad Beans and Cauliflower Poriyal (Recipe In Hindi)
description: चेटिनाड बीन्स और गोभी पोरियल एक सेहतमंद रेसिपी है जिसमे दक्षिण भारत के मसलो का प्रयोग किया जाता है. इस सब्ज़ी में सब्ज़िओ को तड़का दिया जाता है और खाने में साइड डिश के जैसे परोसा जाता है. आप इस डिश को सलाद की तरह भी खा सकते है.
ingredients_name: Cauliflower,Green Beans,Mustard Seeds,White Urad Dal,Curry Leaves,Red Chili Powder,Turmeric Powder,Salt,Sesame Oil
ingredients_quantity: 1 गोभी , टुकड़े कर ले  200 ग्राम हरा बीन्स , बारीक काट ले  1 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1 छोटा चमच्च सफ़ेद उरद दाल  1 टहनी कढ़ी पत्ता  1 छोटा चमच्च लाल मिर्च पाउडर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर नमक , स्वाद अनुसार  1 बड़ा चमच्च तिल का तेल
instructions: चेटिनाड बीन्स और गोभी पोरियल बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले सारी सब्जिआ काट ले. अब गोभी और बीन्स को एक स्टीमर में नमक के साथ डाले और नरम होने तक पका ले. एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें राइ, उरद दाल डाले और हल्का भूरा होने तक पकाए। अब इसमें कढ़ी पत्ता, लाल मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर, नमक और भापी हुई सब्जिआ डाले। सबको मिला ले और 2 मिनट तक पकने दे. परोसे। चेटिनाड बीन्स और गोभी पोरियल को मिक्स्ड वेजिटेबल सांबर और चावल के साथ परोसे।

name: Thumbprint Salted Caramel Chocolate Cookies Recipe
description: A mildly sweet delicious aroma of cookies in air is more inviting than most desserts when you want to have something for snacks during evening. This cookie will definitely please your kids and their friends. with holiday season coming up, this is an excellent cookie to prepare in advance and share. You can also make this with your kids for a fun winter afternoon. This cookie dough can be prepared and stored in advance to bake and this also is a keeper recipe. You can prepare it and store in airtight container for about a week.
ingredients_name: Vivatta Maida,Cocoa Powder,Baking soda,Salt,Butter (Unsalted),Brown Sugar (Demerara Sugar),Whole Egg,Vanilla Extract,Chocolate chips,Salt,Condensed Milk
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Vivatta Maida  1/3 cup Cocoa Powder  1/2 teaspoon Baking soda  1/4 teaspoon Salt  110 grams Butter (Unsalted)  3/4 cup Brown Sugar (Demerara Sugar)  1 Whole Egg  2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract  3/4 cup Chocolate chips Salt , a pinch, to sprinkle  350 ml Condensed Milk
instructions: To begin making Thumbprint Salted Caramel Chocolate Cookies Recipe, preheat oven to 350 degrees F.Whisk together flour, cocoa powder, baking soda and salt; set aside.In a large bowl, beat butter , brown sugar, egg, vanilla and  until creamy and smooth; about 1-2 minutes. Add in flour mixture and incorporate until well combined.Fold in the chocolate chips.Roll into small dough balls or use a small cookie scoop to drop on a baking sheet and flatten slightly with the palm of your hand. Bake 8-10 minutes. I like to take mine out at 9 minutes so they remain soft. Then press the cookies with back of scoop kind of spoon when it is warm. Cool completely.For the caramel sauce, pour the condensed milk can in a microwave safe bowl then heat 5 mins stirring at intervals till your sauce is done with brownish in color. Cool this a bit and then pour in the caramel sauce in the cookies. Sprinkle with sea salt immediately. This recipe made about 16 cookies.Serve Thumbprint Salted Caramel Chocolate Cookies Recipe along with Homemade Hot Chocolate with Whipped Cream Recipe.

name: शिमला मिर्च की सब्ज़ी रेसिपी - No Onion No Garlic Sweet Pepper Sabji (Recipe In Hindi)
description: शिमला मिर्च की सब्ज़ी एक सरल सब्ज़ी है जो आप अपने लंच बॉक्स के लिए बना सकते है. इस सब्ज़ी में लाल और पिली शिमला मिर्च का प्रयोग किया जाता है. यह सब्ज़ी बनाने में आसान है और बहुत कम समय में तैयार हो जाती है.
ingredients_name: Yellow Bell Pepper,Red Bell Pepper,Peanut Powder,Sesame Powder,Goda Masala,Red Chili Powder,Turmeric Powder,Asafoetida,Tamarind Paste,Jaggery,Oil,Mustard Seeds,Cumin,Coriander Leaves
ingredients_quantity: 1 शिमला मिर्च (पिली) , काट ले  1 शिमला मिर्च (लाल) , काट ले  1 बड़ा चमच्च मूंगफली पाउडर  2 छोटे चमच्च तिल का पाउडर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च गोडा मसाला , वैक्लपिक  1/2 छोटा चमच्च लाल मिर्च पाउडर  1/4 हल्दी पाउडर  1/4 छोटा चमच्च हींग  1 छोटा चमच्च इमली का पेस्ट  1-1/2 छोटा चमच्च गुड़ , कस ले  2 छोटे चमच्च तेल  1/2 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1/2 छोटा चमच्च जीरा हरा धनिया , प्रयोग अनुसार, काट ले
instructions: शिमला मिर्च की सब्ज़ी बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें राइ और जीरा डाले। 15 सेकण्ड्स तक पकने के बाद इसमें हल्दी पाउडर, लाल मिर्च पाउडर और गोडा मसाला डाले। 30 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसमें लाल और पिली शिमला मिर्च डाले और मिला ले. नमक डाले, कढ़ाई को ढके और 2 मिनट तक पकने दे. अब इसमें इमली का पेस्ट, गुड़, मूंगफली का पाउडर, तिल का पाउडर और 3 चमच्च पानी डाले। 2 से 3 मिनट के लिए पकाए। पकने के बाद गैस बंद करें और हरे धनिये से गार्निश करें। शिमला मिर्च की सब्ज़ी को दाल फ्राई, भिंडी रायता और फुल्के के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे.

description: पनीर भुर्जी ग्रेवी एक सरल और स्वादिष्ट रेसिपी है जिसे आप अपनी हाउस पार्टीज के लिए बना सकते है. इसमें रोज के मसालो का प्रयोग किया जाता है और आप इसे अपने लंच बॉक्स में भी पैक कर सकते है.
ingredients_name: Oil,Cumin,Mustard Seeds,Asafoetida,Bay Leaf,Dried Red Chilli,Cloves,Black Cardamom,Cardamom,Onion,Ginger,Garlic,Tomato Puree,Tomato,Green Peas,Paneer,Coriander Leaves,Red Chili Powder,Turmeric Powder,Star Anise,Coriander Powder,Garam Masala Powder,Salt,Water
ingredients_quantity: तेल , प्रयोग अनुसार  1/2 छोटा चमच्च जीरा  1/2 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1/4 छोटा चमच्च हींग  1 तेज पत्ता  1 सुखी लाल मिर्च  2 लॉन्ग  1 बड़ी इलाइची  2 इलाइची  1 प्याज , बारीक काट ले  1/2 बड़ा चमच्च अदरक , पेस्ट बना ले  1/2 बड़ा चमच्च लहसुन , पेस्ट बना ले  1/4 कप टमाटर प्यूरी  1 टमाटर , काट ले  1/4 कप हरे मटर , उबालकर मैश कर ले  1 कप पनीर , चुरा कर ले हरा धनिया , थोड़ा, काट ले  1 छोटा चमच्च लाल मिर्च पाउडर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर  1 स्टार अनीस  1 छोटा चमच्च धनिया पाउडर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च गरम मसाला पाउडर नमक , प्रयोग अनुसार पानी , प्रयोग अनुसार
instructions: पनीर भुर्जी ग्रेवी बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें जीरा, राइ, तेज पत्ता, सुखी लाल मिर्च, बड़ी इलाइची, इलाइची और हींग डाले। 15 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसमें प्याज डाले और प्याज के नरम होने तक पकाए। प्याज के नरम होने के बाद इसमें अदरक लहुसन का पेस्ट डाले और 2 मिनट तक पकने दे. 2 मिनट बाद इसमें टमाटर और टमाटर की प्यूरी डाले। कढ़ाई को ढके और 3 से 4 मिनट तक पकने दे. इसके बाद इसमें लाल मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर, धनिया पाउडर, गरम मसाला पाउडर और नमक डाले। 5 मिनट तक पकने दे. 5 मिनट के बाद इसमें पनीर और पानी डाले। सबको मिला ले और 6 से 8 मिनट तक पकने दे. अब इसमें उबले हुए हरे मटर डाले, मिलाए, कढ़ाई को ढके और अगले 3 से 5 मिनट तक पकने दे. पकने के बाद, गैस बंद करें और हरे धनिये से गार्निश करें। पनीर भुर्जी ग्रेवी को पालक रायता और तवा पराठे के साथ रात के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: पापड़ एर डालना रेसिपी - Bengali Style Papad Curry (Recipe In Hindi)
description: पापड़ एर डालना एक बंगाली करी है जिसे दुर्गा पूजा के समय बनाया जाता है. यह उन दिनों के लिए एक दम पर्याप्त रेसिपी है जब आप कुछ स्वादिष्ट खाना चाहते है लेकिन जिसे बनाने में काम समय लगता है.
ingredients_name: Papad,Potato,Tomato,Ginger,Bay Leaf,Dried Red Chilli,Cumin,Cumin Powder,Turmeric Powder,Red Chili Powder,Sugar,Garam Masala Powder,Salt,Oil,Ghee
ingredients_quantity: 4 पापड़ , मसाले वाला  4 आलू  1 टमाटर  1 इंच अदरक , कस ले  1 तेज पत्ता  1 सुखी लाल मिर्च  1/2 छोटा चमच्च जीरा  1 छोटा चमच्च जीरा पाउडर  1 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च लाल मिर्च पाउडर  1 छोटा चमच्च शक्कर  1 छोटा चमच्च गरम मसाला पाउडर नमक , स्वाद अनुसार  2 छोटा चमच्च तेल  1 छोटा चमच्च घी
instructions: पापड़ एर डालना बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले आलू को धो कर छील ले. इन आलू को आधा काट ले. टमाटर को मिक्सर ग्राइंडर में डाले और पीस ले. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें आलू डाले और सुनहरा होने तक पका ले. अलग से रख दे. पापड़ के टुकड़े कर ले और इन्हे तेल में डालकर तल ले. पापड़ को निकाल ले और अलग से रख दे.  इसी कढ़ाई में अब तेज पत्ता, सुखी लाल मिर्च और जीरा डाले। 20 सेकण्ड्स तक पकने दे. अब इसमें टमाटर प्यूरी डाले और 2 मिनट तक पकने दे. इसके बाद इसमें अदरक का पेस्ट डाले और 2 से 3 मिनट तक पकाए। 3 मिनट बाद इसमें हल्दी पाउडर, लाल मिर्च पाउडर, जीरा पाउडर और 1 चमच्च पानी डाले। सबको अच्छी तरह से मिला ले. शक्कर, नमक डाले और 3 से 5 मिनट तक पकने दे. अब इसमें तले हुए आलू और 1-1/2 कप पानी डाले। कढ़ाई को ढके और आलू के पकने तक पकाए। इसके बाद इसमें पापड़ डाले, मिए और अगले 3 मिनट तक पकाए। 3 मिनट के बाद गरम मसाला पाउडर, घी डाले और 2 मिनट तक पकाए। गैस बंद करें और परोसे। पापड़ एर डालना को छोलार दाल और चावल के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: Cucumber Mor Kuzhambu Recipe - Cucumber Mor Kuzhambu (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Cucumber Mor Kolamb is a delicious curry that can be served with rice. Soft cucumbers are cooked in a gravy of coconut and mustard seeds. Everyday spices are used in it. You can also use fresh pumpkin instead of cucumber.
ingredients_name: Cucumber,Coconut,Ginger,Mustard Seeds,Green Chilli,Turmeric Powder,Coriander Leaves,Hung Yogurt,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 3 cucumber, peeled and chopped 1/2 cup coconut 1 inch ginger, chopped 1 teaspoon mustard seeds 4 green chillies, chopped 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder 5 sprigs coriander leaves 2 tablespoons hung curd Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Cucumber Mor Kolamba first chop the cucumber. Now put it in a saucepan with 1/2 cup water and salt and cook till it becomes soft. Now put coconut, ginger, green chilies, mustard seeds, coriander powder, turmeric powder in a mixer grinder and make a paste. Add some water to it and grind it again. Add this paste to the cucumber and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Add salt, curd and mix it. Serve hot. Serve Cucumber Mor Kolamba with Rice and Beetroot Thoran for lunch.

name: Turkish Baklava Recipe From Scratch
description: Baklava is a crunchy, nutty, sweet with a hint of lemon & cinnamon. You can indulge in all the flavors & elements of this dessert in one bite.
ingredients_name: Vivatta Maida,Salt,Lemon juice,Extra Virgin Olive Oil,Lukewarm Water,Corn flour,Vivatta Maida,Pistachios,Whole Almonds (Badam),Cashew nuts,Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini),Butter (Unsalted),Sugar,Water,Honey,Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini),Cloves (Laung),Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini),Nutmeg powder,Lemon juice,Lemon zest
ingredients_quantity: For Phyllo dough: 1 cup Vivatta Maida  1/8 teaspoon Salt , (a pinch)  2 teaspoons Lemon juice  1 teaspoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil  3/8 cup Lukewarm Water , (divided-1/4 + 1/8) For Rolling out phyllo pastry sheets: 50 grams Corn flour  50 grams Vivatta Maida For Filling: 1/3 cup Pistachios , chopped & toasted lightly  1/3 cup Whole Almonds (Badam) , chopped & toasted lightly  1/3 cup Cashew nuts , chopped & toasted lightly  1/2 teaspoon Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini) For Topping: 120 grams Butter (Unsalted) For Honey Syrup: 1/2 cup Sugar  1-1/2 cup Water  1/2 cup Honey  1 inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini)  3 Cloves (Laung)  1 pinch Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini)  1 pinch Nutmeg powder  1 teaspoon Lemon juice  1 teaspoon Lemon zest
instructions: To begin making Turkish Baklava Recipe From Scratch, prepare the homemade phyllo sheet first. *Making of Phyllo sheet:Mix all purpose flour, salt, olive oil & lemon juice together in a mixing bowl.Take warm water and add it to flour mixture gradually until it forms smooth dough. Let it stand for atleast an hour.After an hour, divide the dough into two & make about 16 small balls from each & sprinkle some starch mixture over them.Take one of the balls & roll it out as thin as you can, with the help of a rolling pin. (My baking tray was of 14 cm circular tray so I rolled out phyllo sheet to completely fit in the baking tray. You can measure it as per your requirement and roll the sheets)Your hand should be visible through the sheet when it is completely rolled out. Sprinkle some starch mixture over it and put it aside covering it with a damp towel.Roll out other balls in the same way and put them on the each other sprinkling the starch mixture between their layers. Keep phyllo sheets covered with a damp towel.*Nuts mixture:Put nuts in a food processor and pulse until they are coarsely grounded. Add sugar and grounded cinnamon to it and mix. Keep aside*Assembling of Baklava:Preheat the oven at 180C. Brush baking tray with butter.Place 10 phyllo sheets into baking tray one at a time, brushing each sheet with butter.Spread 1/3 cup of nuts mixture over layered phyllo sheets.Now again place 6 layers of phyllo sheets in to baking tray at a time, brushing each sheet with butter. This time brush it gently or just drizzle butter so that nutty layer doesn’t get disturbed.Again spread 1/3 cup of nuts mixture and place 6 layers of phyllo sheets applying butter in between the layers.Spread 1/3 cup of nuts mixture and place the last 10 layers of phyllo sheets applying butter in between layers. Brush top layer with butter gently.Now use a thin & sharp knife to cut it in to square or diamond shape pieces. This step is very important because if you skip it, you can’t get perfect pieces once it is baked.Bake this in preheated oven at 180C for 10 minutes and then at 170C for 20 minutes and at 140C for 30 minutes. CHeck with your oven settings since each oven differs in its heating capabilities.*Making of Honey syrup:In the meantime when the baklava is baking, make honey syrup.Take all the ingredient for honey syrup in a sauce pan & bring it to boil, then let it simmer for 20 – 30 minutes until it gets soft ball consistency.Take baklava from the oven once done & pour honey syrup over it generously.Sprinkle some nuts mixture over it. Let it cool for about 30 minutes before serving. You can serve it warm or cold.Serve Turkish Baklava Recipe From Scratch as a dessert after a scrumptious sandwich like Chicken Sandwich With Sweet Corn and Tandoori Potato Wedges Recipe with friends and family on a weekend.

name: Moong Dal Methi Ki Sabzi Recipe - Moong Dal Methi Ki Sabzi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Methi Moong Dal Sabzi is a delicious dish in which lentils are cooked with fenugreek. This is a dry dish so you can pack it in your lunch box as well.
ingredients_name: Green Moong Dal,Fenugreek,Tomato,Onion,Green Chilli,Cumin,Ginger,Cumin,Turmeric Powder,Coriander Powder,Cumin Powder,Asafoetida,Oil,Water
ingredients_quantity: 1/2 cup green moong dal, soaked for 3 hours 2 cups fenugreek leaves, finely chopped 2 tomatoes, thinly sliced ​​1 onion, thinly sliced ​​4 green chillies, chopped 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 1 teaspoon ginger, grated 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder 3/4 teaspoon coriander powder 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder Asafoetida, a pinch 2 tablespoons oil 1/2 cup water
instructions: To make Moong Dal Methi Sabzi, first heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let it cook for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds add green chillies, asafoetida and let it cook for few seconds, now add onion and cook till onion becomes soft. After onion becomes soft, add ginger, tomatoes and let it cook for 2 minutes. Now add moong dal, turmeric powder, coriander powder and cook for 1 minute. Now add 1/2 cup water, salt and mix everything. Cover the pan and let it cook for 7 to 8 minutes. Add fenugreek and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes. Serve hot. Serve Methi Moong Dal with Rajasthani Kadhi and Phulkas for lunch.

name: Bajra Matar Ki Khichdi Recipe – Bajra Matar Ki Khichdi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Bajra matar khichdi is a breakfast recipe mostly made in Haryana and Rajasthan. This khichdi is full of nutrition and you can also make it with kadhi for your dinner. In this, millet and peas are cooked with everyday spices. Easy to make and full of nutrition, make this khichdi once.
ingredients_name: Bajra Flour,Yellow Moong Dal,Oil,Mustard Seeds,Cumin,Asafoetida,Onion,Tomato,Potato,Carrot,Green Peas,Red Chili Powder,Ginger Garlic Paste,Coriander Powder,Garam Masala Powder,Turmeric Powder,Salt,Coriander Leaves,Lemon Juice
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup millet flour 1/2 cup yellow moong dal 1 tbsp oil 1/2 tsp mustard seeds 1/2 tsp cumin seeds 1/4 tsp asafoetida 1 onion, finely chopped 1 tomato, finely chopped 1 potato, chopped 1 carrot, chopped 1/4 cup green peas 1 tsp red chilli powder 1 tsp ginger garlic paste 1 tsp coriander powder 1/2 tsp garam masala powder 1 tsp turmeric powder 1/2 tsp salt 2 tbsp coriander leaves, finely chopped 1 tbsp lemon juice
instructions: To make Bajra Matar Khichdi, first soak the millet for 4 hours. Soak moong dal in water for 1 hour. Now take a pressure cooker. Add millet, moong dal, green chillies and turmeric powder in it. Add 4 cups of water and cook till 4 whistles. Let the pressure release automatically and keep it aside. Now heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds, mustard seeds, asafoetida and let it cook for 15 seconds. Let the cumin seeds cook till it becomes light brown. Add onion and cook till the onion becomes soft. After the onion becomes soft, add tomatoes and cook till the tomatoes become soft. After the tomatoes become soft, add all the vegetables and mix. Now add red chilli powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, salt and cook till the vegetables become soft. Now add cooked millet and let it cook for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes turn off the gas and garnish with green coriander. Add lemon juice and mix well. Serve Bajra Peas Khichdi along with Rajasthani Khichdi and Masala Khichia for dinner.

name: Tomato Upma Recipe - Tomato Upma (Recipe In Hindi)
description: If you want to try something new for breakfast then try this Tomato Upma. Adding tomatoes enhances the taste of this upma and since it is easy to make, you can make it for breakfast on your busy mornings.
ingredients_name: Semolina,Tomato,Onion,Green Chilli,Ghee,Mustard Seeds,Dried Red Chilli,Curry Leaves,Asafoetida,Salt,Water,Red Chili Powder,Turmeric Powder,Lemon Juice,Coriander Leaves
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup semolina 2 tomatoes, finely chopped 1 onion, finely chopped 1 green chilli, finely chopped Ghee or oil (as per requirement) 1 teaspoon mustard seeds 1 dried red chilli, broken 6 curry leaves 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida Salt, to taste Water, hot, to taste 1/2 teaspoon red chilli powder 1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder Juice of 1/2 lemon 2 sprigs coriander leaves, finely chopped
instructions: To make Tomato Upma, first take semolina in a pan and fry it till its color changes. Keep it aside after frying. Now heat oil or ghee in a pan. Add mustard seeds, asafoetida, dried red chillies and curry leaves in it. Let it cook for 30 seconds. Now add onion and green chillies in it and cook till the onion becomes soft. Now add tomatoes in it and cook till the tomatoes become soft. After the tomatoes become soft, add red chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt, lemon juice and cook for 3 to 5 minutes. After this add saji and water in it. Keep stirring so that it does not form lumps. Cook for another 5 to 8 minutes and turn off the gas. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot. Serve Tomato Upma with coconut chutney and filter coffee for breakfast.

name: Idli Upma Recipe – Idli Upma (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Idli is made in every South Indian household. Many times Idli is left over. There are many recipes in which you can use Idli but here we will teach you to make an easy recipe. This recipe is perfect for breakfast.
ingredients_name: Idli,Small Onions,Green Chilli,Ginger,Turmeric Powder,Mustard Seeds,White Urad Dal,Curry Leaves,Olive Oil,Coriander Leaves,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 10 idlis, peeled 10 small onions, finely chopped 3 green chillies, finely chopped 1 inch ginger, grated 1/2 tsp turmeric powder 1/2 tsp mustard seeds 1 tsp white urad dal 6 curry leaves, finely chopped 1 tbsp olive oil 2 sprigs coriander leaves, finely chopped Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Idli Upma, first heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and let it cook for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds add urad dal and cook till it turns brown. After it turns brown, add chopped onion, ginger, green chilies and curry leaves. Cook till the onion turns soft. After the onion turns soft, add turmeric powder, Idli and salt. Mix everything well. After it is cooked, add coriander leaves and mix it. Turn off the gas and serve. Serve Idli Upma with fruit bowl and masala tea for breakfast.

name: Broccoli Chocolate Muffins Recipe
description: Broccoli Chocolate Muffins Recipe is an easiest way to sneak in broccoli for kids who are messy eaters. The broccoli that is hidden as an ingredient in these muffins are sly and seldom can be recognised because of the chocolate that we will be adding into it. You can make these for kids birthday parties or just serve as an after school snack. Serve Broccoli Chocolate Muffins Recipe along with Fresh Figs Strawberry and Banana Smoothie Recipe during evening.
ingredients_name: Broccoli,Cocoa Powder,Vivatta Maida,Baking powder,Caster Sugar,Whole Eggs,Milk,Oil,Whole Almonds (Badam)
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Broccoli , chopped finely  3 tablespoons Cocoa Powder  1 cup Vivatta Maida  1 teaspoon Baking powder  3/4 cup Caster Sugar  2 Whole Eggs  1 tablespoon Milk  1/2 cup Oil Whole Almonds (Badam) , a handful, chopped (optional)
instructions: To begin making Broccoli Chocolate Muffins Recipe, grate broccoli and keep it aside. Sieve all the dry ingredients in a bowl.In a separate bowl, whisk in eggs well, then add sugar, milk and oil. Mix well with the help of a hand mixer.Gradually add the dry ingredients now and blend it well.Once done, finally add broccoli and mix along with almonds. Adding almonds is optional but this increases the taste of muffins.Preheat the oven to 180 C. Line up muffin moulds or tray with paper muffin cups. Pour the batter till about 2/3 in each of the cavity.Bake it for 16-20 minutes or until it is cooked. Take off the muffin pan from oven once done and allow them to cool a bit.Serve Broccoli Chocolate Muffins Recipe when they are still warm along with Fresh Figs Strawberry and Banana Smoothie Recipe during evening.

name: Besan Aur Pyaz Ka Cheela Recipe – Besan Aur Pyaz Ka Cheela (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Besan and Onion Cheela is a breakfast dish that you can make for your busy mornings. This cheela requires everyday ingredients and can be packed for your day's lunch as well.
ingredients_name: Besan,Onion,Fennel Seeds,Coriander Leaves,Salt,Olive Oil,Green Chilli,Onions,Green Chutney (Coriander & Mint)
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup gram flour 1 onion, finely chopped 1 teaspoon fennel seeds, ground Coriander leaves, little, finely chopped Salt, to taste Olive oil, as per need 2 green chillies, finely chopped For Serving Onions, thinly slices Green Chutney (Coriander & Mint), for serving
instructions: To make Gram Flour and Onion Cheela, take all the ingredients in a bowl except oil. Add water slowly and mix well. Mix everything well so that it does not form lumps. Do not make it too thick or too thin. Now heat a pan. Pour one spoon of gram flour batter in it and make chilla by rotating it in a circular motion. Pour some oil on all the four sides and cook till both the sides turn golden. Make chillas with the remaining batter and serve them hot. Serve Gram Flour and Onion Cheela with Coriander Mint Chutney and Masala Tea for breakfast.

name: चकुंदर और टमाटर की चटनी रेसिपी - Beetroot and Tomato Chutney (Recipe In Hindi)
description: चकुंदर और टमाटर की चटनी एक स्वादिष्ट रेसिपी है जो पोषण से भरपूर है. यह खाने में तो स्वादिष्ट है ही, बनाने में भी उतनी ही आसान है. इस चटनी में चकुंदर को पकाया नहीं जाता।
ingredients_name: Beetroot,Coriander Leaves,Tomato,Green Chilli,Lemon Juice,Water,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1/2 कप चकुंदर , काट ले  1/2 कप हरा धनिया , काट ले  1/4 कप टमाटर , काट ले  2 हरी मिर्च , काट ले  1 बड़ा चमच्च निम्बू का रस पानी , प्रयोग अनुसार नमक , स्वाद अनुसार
instructions: चकुंदर और टमाटर की चटनी बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले सारी सामग्री तैयार कर ले. अब एक फ़ूड प्रोसेसर में चकुंदर, धनिया, टमाटर, हरी मिर्च डाले और अच्छी तरह से पीस ले.  अब इसमें नमक, थोड़ा पानी और निम्बू का रस डाले और 20 सेकण्ड्स के लिए और पिसे। आपकी चटनी तैयार है. चकुंदर और टमाटर की चटनी को घी रोस्ट मसाला डोसा और फ़िल्टर कॉफ़ी के साथ सुबह के नाश्ते के लिए परोसे.

name: कोल्लु थोगयल - Horsegram Chutney (Recipe In Hindi)
description: कोल्लु थोगयल एक चटनी है जिसमे दाल को सेक कर नारियल और मसालो के साथ परोसा जाता है. इसमें कोल्लु दाल का प्रयोग होता है जो इसे नटी फ्लेवर देता है. इस चटनी को हर दक्षिण भारतीय घर में बनाया जाता है.
ingredients_name: Horse Gram,Chana Dal,Black Urad Dal,Coconut,Dried Red Chilli,Oil,Mustard Seeds,Curry Leaves,Asafoetida,Turmeric Powder,Salt,Water
ingredients_quantity: 3 कुलीथ दाल  1 बड़ा चमच्च चना दाल  1 बड़ा चमच्च काली उरद दाल  1/4 कप नारियल , कस ले  2 सुखी लाल मिर्च  1 छोटा चमच्च तेल  1 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1 टहनी कढ़ी पत्ता हींग , चुटकी भर हल्दी पाउडर , चुटकी भर नमक , स्वाद अनुसार पानी , प्रयोग अनुसार
instructions: कोल्लु थोगयल को बनाने के लिए सब्ज़े पहले एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम कर ले. अब इसमें राइ डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स तक पकने दे.10 सेकण्ड्स के बाद इसमें हींग, कढ़ी पत्ता, सुखी लाल मिर्च, चना दाल और उरद दाल डाले। मिलाए और 15 सेकण्ड्स तक पकने दे. 15 सेकण्ड्स के बाद इसमें हल्दी पाउडर और दाल डाले। 2 से 3 मिनट के लिए पकाए। गैस बंद करें और इसमें नारियल डाले। ठंडा होने के बाद थोड़ा पानी डालकर इसका पेस्ट बना ले. नमक डाले और फिर से एक बार पीस ले. परोसे। कोल्लु थोगयल को मिक्स्ड वेजिटेबल सांबर, चावल और चाउ चाउ थोरन के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: Orange Marmalade Tea Cake Recipe
description: Orange Marmalade Tea Cake is simple and easy to make and tastes delicious even without any frosting. The sticky orange marmalade lends a fresh, citrusy burst to the cake and is a perfect accompaniment to a cup of tea or coffee. Apart from increasing the health quotient, the olive oil also adds its characteristic flavour to the cake. The whole wheat flour and almond flour are part substitutes for Maida, without altering the taste or texture of the cake. You can also substitute the white sugar with brown sugar to make this orange Marmalade cake an absolute guilt-free tea time snack!
ingredients_name: All Purpose Flour (Maida),Whole Wheat Flour,Almond Meal (Badam Powder),Salt,Baking powder,Baking soda,Extra Virgin Olive Oil,Fresh orange juice,Whole Eggs,Orange marmalade jam,Caster Sugar,Buttermilk,Orange marmalade jam
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup All Purpose Flour (Maida)  3/4 cup Whole Wheat Flour  1/4 cup Almond Meal (Badam Powder)  1/4 teaspoon Salt  1-1/2 teaspoon Baking powder  1/2 teaspoon Baking soda  1/3 cup Extra Virgin Olive Oil  1 teaspoon Fresh orange juice  2 Whole Eggs  3 tablespoon Orange marmalade jam , slightly warmed and then cooled  3/4 cup Caster Sugar  1/2 cup Buttermilk , (or milk+1/2 tablespoon vinegar)  4 tablespoon Orange marmalade jam , to drizzle/brush on the cake
instructions: To begin with Orange Marmalade Tea Cake, preheat the oven to 180 degree celcius. Prepare two 5 inch round pan or one 9 inch round pan or one 9 inch loaf pan.Sieve the flours, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a mixing bowl. Set it aside.In another mixing bowl, beat the eggs till fluffy. Add in the sugar, oil, marmalade, orange extract and whisk till blended properly.Fold in the dry ingredients with the wet, alternating with the addition of buttermilk.Pour the batter in the prepared pan and bake for about 30-35 minutes or till a cake tester comes out clean (time will vary depending on the oven and size of pan).Carefully invert the cakes after 5 minutes onto a cooling rack and cool. (Run a knife around the edges of the pan to loosen the cake from the sides).Drizzle the Marmalade over the cakes when it is warm and not hot.Serve Orange Marmalade Tea Cake with a hot cup of coffee or Masala chai.

name: Oats Carrot Cake Cookies Recipe
description: We all love cookies but health conscious people think twice before eating them because of sugar and butter. Well, this Oats Carrot Cake Cookies Recipe for sure will lessen your guilt and you can enjoy cookies. This recipe is easy to make and it has some healthy ingredients like oats, carrots and nuts. Just few ingredients and we are sorted for the recipe. Serve Oats Carrot Cake Cookies Recipe and Healthy Rose Cookies Recipe With Persian Twist along with Cinnamon Spiced Black Lemon Tea Recipe.
ingredients_name: Instant Oats (Oatmeal),Whole Wheat Flour,Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini),Baking powder,Sea salt,Walnuts,Sultana Raisins,Ginger,Carrot (Gajjar),Whole Egg,Honey,Coconut Oil
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Instant Oats (Oatmeal)  3/4 cup Whole Wheat Flour  1 tablespoon Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini)  1 tablespoon Baking powder  1/4 tablespoon Sea salt , or to taste  8 Walnuts , chopped  4 tablespoons Sultana Raisins  1/4 tablespoon Ginger , grated  1-1/2 cup Carrot (Gajjar) , grated  1 Whole Egg  1/2 cup Honey  1/2 cup Coconut Oil
instructions: To begin making Oats Carrot Cake Cookies Recipe, preheat oven at 180 degree.In a large mixing bowl, add oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and grated ginger. Mix everything well.Add grated carrot, walnuts and raisins. Stir to combine.Take another bowl and mix honey and oil together, whisk it properly so that oil n honey mix together properly.Add one large egg and beat it again (if you don't eat egg, you can skip this part)Add oil, honey and egg mixture to our first mixing bowl which is having flour and oats mixture.Fold the mixture well and make a dough, now cover the dough with plastic cling film and keep it in fridge.After 15-20 minutes, take the dough out and scoop out some dough with a spoon or ice cream scoop, spread on baking tray lined with parchment paper. Flattened each cookie dough by using ur palm.Repeat the same process with rest of the dough.Make sure that you leave space between each cookie .Bake at 180 degree for 15-17 minutes or until golden and firm around the edges.Cool down the cookies for 10 minutes and cookies are ready to eat.Serve Oats Carrot Cake Cookies Recipe and Healthy Rose Cookies Recipe With Persian Twist along with Cinnamon Spiced Black Lemon Tea Recipe.

name: Ulundhu Kali Recipe (Urad Dal Sweet)
description: Ulundhu kali is a healthy, traditional south Indian dish rich in protein and dietary fibers. This kali is very good for women, girls and aged people as it strengthens bones. This is given to pregnant women and also to girls when they reach the age of puberty. This is believed to strengthen the bones. Serve Ulundhu Kali Recipe (Urad Dal Sweet) during tea time with Irani Chai Recipe and Namak Para Recipe (Deep Fried Biscuits).
ingredients_name: White Urad Dal (Split),Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds),Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seeds,Dry ginger powder,Palm jaggery,Water,Salt,Gingelly oil
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup White Urad Dal (Split)  1 teaspoon Methi Seeds (Fenugreek Seeds)  3 Cardamom (Elaichi) Pods/Seeds , pounded  1/2 teaspoon Dry ginger powder  1 cup Palm jaggery  2-1/2 cups Water Salt , a pinch  4 tablespoons Gingelly oil
instructions: To begin making Ulundhu Kali Recipe (Urad Dal Sweet), add urad dal, fenugreek seeds and Cardamom to a mixer and grind into smooth powder. Keep aside.Now for preparing jaggery syrup, add jaggery and water to a pan and boil. Stir until jaggery dissolves and strain to remove impurities.Pour the filtered jaggery syrup back to the pan. Add salt and dry ginger powder to it. Stir well and bring it to boil.Add the Urad dal flour little by little and keep stirring without forming lumps.Once the flour and jaggery is combined well, add 2 tsp of gingelly oil at regular intervals and keep mixing with ladle.The mixture has to become thick combining together without sticking to sides of the pan. Once done, switch off the flame and allow it to cool.Grease the hands with oil and take small portion of dough and roll into medium sized balls and wait till they cool down to serve.Serve Ulundhu Kali Recipe (Urad Dal Sweet) during tea time with Irani Chai Recipe and Namak Para Recipe (Deep Fried Biscuits).

name: Dark Chocolate Cherry Cake Recipe
description: Dark Chocolate Cherry Cake Recipe is a rich, dark chocolate cake which is soft, moist and absolutely divine with cherry on the top, literally! The chopped cherries in the cake add a slight tanginess which goes very well with chocolate. The cake being healthy made with whole wheat flour, oats and organic raw sugar. Serve Dark Chocolate Cherry Cake Recipe with Thai Ice Tea Recipe during evening. You can also have it any time of day when you have craving for something sweet.
ingredients_name: Whole Wheat Flour,Instant Oats (Oatmeal),Sugar,Cocoa Powder,Dark chocolate,Fresh Cherries,Whole Eggs,Oil,Hot water,Milk,Vanilla Extract,Baking powder,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1/2 cup Whole Wheat Flour , (I used organic wheat flour)  1/2 cup Instant Oats (Oatmeal) , powdered  3/4 cup Sugar , (I used organic raw sugar)  1/4 cup Cocoa Powder  1/4 cup Dark chocolate , chopped  1/3 cup Fresh Cherries , pitted and chopped, more for garnish  2 Whole Eggs  1/4 cup Oil  1/4 cup Hot water  1/2 cup Milk , warm  1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract  1 teaspoon Baking powder Salt , a pinch
instructions: To begin making Dark Chocolate Cherry Cake Recipe, sift together the flours, cocoa powder, salt and baking powder in a mixing bowl for about 3-4 times.Beat the eggs well. To that, add sugar and beat well. Add vanilla extract and oil, mix them.Add the flour mixture alternating with milk, fold them lightly until they are incorporated, do not over mix.Add the boiling hot water to the batter and mix well. This step is very important for the right flavour of the chocolate.Add pitted cherries and dark chocolate chunks, fold them gently.Pour the batter into a greased baking dish and bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 30-40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. Bake it according to your oven since the temperature, and capacity of baking differs with ovens.Serve Dark Chocolate Cherry Cake Recipe topped with more cherres along with Thai Ice Tea Recipe during evening.

name: Asian Carrot Ginger Lentil Soup Recipe
description: Asian Lentil Soup is a healthy recipe with full of protein and fiber contents. If you are a traveller or have to depend on eating most of the meals from outside then lentil soups from soup menu are best alternatives.  Asian vegetables and the broth that well tempered in sesame oil with a spoonful of soya sauce is the magic behind the transformation in taste. Apart we all can cook this variation for making daily lentil dish. It is simply delicious and children will love to eat as nutritious soup meal if you add a cup of rice in it.
ingredients_name: Mixed lentils,Carrot (Gajjar),Onion,Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum),Celery,Ginger,Fresh Red Chilli,Vegetable stock,Dark soy sauce,Sesame (Gingelly) Oil,Sesame seeds (Til seeds),Spring Onion (Bulb & Greens),Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1/2 cup Mixed lentils  1 Carrot (Gajjar)  1 Onion  1 Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum)  1 Celery  2 inch Ginger , sliced  1 Fresh Red Chilli  2-1/2 cup Vegetable stock  1 teaspoon Dark soy sauce  1 teaspoon Sesame (Gingelly) Oil  1/4 teaspoon Sesame seeds (Til seeds)  2 Spring Onion (Bulb & Greens) Salt , to taste
instructions: To begin making the Asian Carrot Ginger Lentil Soup recipe, wash the lentil and soak for 5 minutes.Cut the vegetables in chunks and the scallion into long thin strips. Heat a medium saucepan with oil, ginger, red chilli and sesame seed. Let it cook for about 15 seconds.After 15 seconds, add the celery and onions fry for a minute. After a minute, add rest of the vegetables. Mix it properly and let it cook for another minute.After a minute, add the water and lentil. Let it fully cook until the grains start to break. Add soya sauce and salt. Pour the soup in a big soup bowl and garnish with scallions on top.

name: Upside Down Choco Orange Cake Recipe
description: Upside Down Choco Orange Cake Recipe is a delicious upside down orange cake filled with lots of chocolate chips - with a melt-in-the-mouth light texture. Wheat flour makes it very healthy.
ingredients_name: Vivatta Maida,Whole Wheat Flour,Baking powder,Baking soda,Orange Zest (Rind),Butter (Unsalted),Sugar,Fresh orange juice,Whole Eggs,Chocolate chips,Butter (Unsalted),Brown Sugar (Demerara Sugar),Oranges
ingredients_quantity: For the cake 90 gram Vivatta Maida  90 gram Whole Wheat Flour  2 teaspoons Baking powder  1/4 teaspoon Baking soda  1 tablespoon Orange Zest (Rind)  140 grams Butter (Unsalted)  150 grams Sugar  3/4 cup Fresh orange juice , (divided)  2 Whole Eggs  1/2 cup Chocolate chips For the topping 4 tablespoons Butter (Unsalted)  1/3 cup Brown Sugar (Demerara Sugar)  3 Oranges , sliced
instructions: To begin making Upside Down Choco Orange Cake Recipe, proceed with preparing the topping first. Melt the butter in a pan on medium heat, taking care to ensure that it does not burn. Add demerara sugar.Let the mixture boil. Remove from heat after about 1 minute when it is caramelised.Pour the mixture into round springform baking pan. Roll the pan to ensure that the mixture coats the bottom of the pan completely. Set it aside.

name: Blueberry Parfait Recipe
description: The Blueberry Parfait Recipe is a delicious party dessert made with layers of biscuit, whipped cream and blueberries. You could use any berry of your choice and this will taste just delicious. You can also add flavors of liqueurs like orange or lemon to the whipped cream to enhance the flavor and taste of the parfait.
ingredients_name: Marie Biscuit,Butter (Salted),Sugar,Blueberries,Blueberry Jam,Heavy whipping cream,Vanilla Extract
ingredients_quantity: 6 Marie Biscuit , or bourbon biscuits, crumbled  2 tablespoons Butter (Salted) , 2 tablespoons butter   2 tablespoons Sugar , icing sugar  1 cup Blueberries , fresh  1/2 cup Blueberry Jam  1 cup Heavy whipping cream  1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
instructions: To begin making the Blueberry Parfait, combine the biscuit crumbs along with melted butter and icing sugar.Whisk the cream and vanilla essence until it forms stiff peaks. Keep this asideNow your final step is to layer the Blueberry Parfait into dessert glasses or cups.Layer starting with biscuit crumbs, then alternatively keep adding the whipped cream, blueberries, jam, cream and finally top off with the blueberries.Refrigerate the Blueberry Parfait for about 5 hours and serve as a dessert for the holiday parties.

name: Chocolate Flan Cake Recipe
description: Chocolate flan cake is a fusion bake with two different textures and taste variations dancing on your taste buds. This flan cake recipe can be paired with ice cream too for a more enticing taste treat. Making this cake is relatively simple than it looks. Try out this flan cake recipe when you have a gathering at home and this is sure to be an instant hit among the crowd.
ingredients_name: Vivatta Maida,Sugar,Cocoa Powder,Baking powder,Baking soda,Salt,Whole Eggs,Milk,Oil,Vanilla Extract,Hot water,Britannia Cream Cheese,Whole Eggs,Condensed Milk,Evaporated milk,Vanilla Extract
ingredients_quantity: Ingredients for chocolate cake  1-3/4 cups Vivatta Maida , (225grams)  2 cups Sugar  3/4 cup Cocoa Powder  1-1/2 teaspoon Baking powder  1-1/2 teaspoon Baking soda  1/2 teaspoon Salt  2 Whole Eggs  1 cup Milk  1/2 cup Oil  2 teaspoon Vanilla Extract  1 cup Hot water Ingredients for flan 4 fl oz Britannia Cream Cheese , softened  4 Whole Eggs , at room temperature  14 fl oz Condensed Milk  12 fl oz Evaporated milk  1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
instructions: To begin making Chocolate Flan Cake Recipe, preheat the oven to 350 F.Melt 4 tablespoons of sugar in a broad saucepan, on low heat till the sugar starts caramelising.Once it browns, pour the caramelized sugar to the base of the bundt pan and twirl around to coat.In a large mixing bowl, stir together the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda and salt until everything is blended. Add the cake batter to the mould.In a separate mixing bowl, combine the eggs, milk, oil and vanilla and whisk to combine. Then whisk in the boiling water.Now add the wet ingredients to the dry and stir until combined. Combine cream cheese, eggs, sweetened condensed milk, evaporated milk and vanilla in blender container. Process until blended. Pour slowly over the cake batter. (While baking, the cake rises and the milk mixture goes to the bottom) Coat piece of foil with no-stick cooking spray.Cover pan, coated side down, tightly with foil. Place it in a large roasting pan. Pour hot water into roasting pan to a depth of about 2 inches.Bake it for one hour or till the toothpick comes out clean. Let it cool very well and preferably overnight in refrigerator. Then unmold it, slice and serve.Serve Chocolate Flan Cake Recipe after a dinner of a Greek Style Gigantes Plaki Recipe and lemon broken rice.

name: Cheesy Potato Peas Potli Recipe
description: Kids and adults are equally fond of eating cheese. When the cheese is artfully mixed with tangy peas and potato stuffing in these potlis, then the combination ought to be delicious. Along with the taste the interesting shape of these potlis make them a favorite amongst kids. These cheesy potlis are an ideal snack with tea and coffee. They can even be served as starters for house parties. Serve Cheesy Potato Peas Potli Recipe along with tomato ketchup and Peanut Chilli Dipping Sauce Recipe.
ingredients_name: Vivatta Maida,Oil,Salt,Water,Ajwain (Carom seeds),Baking soda,Potatoes (Aloo),Green peas (Matar),Onion,Cheese,Green Chilli,Ginger,Kasuri Methi (Dried Fenugreek Leaves),Cumin seeds (Jeera),Amchur (Dry Mango Powder),Turmeric powder (Haldi),Red Chilli powder,Garam masala powder,Coriander Powder (Dhania),Coriander (Dhania) Leaves,Salt,Oil
