ingredients_name: All Purpose Flour (Maida),Red Chilli flakes,Dried oregano,Extra Virgin Olive Oil,Salt,Lukewarm Water,Sesame seeds (Til seeds),Black sesame seeds
ingredients_quantity: 2 cups All Purpose Flour (Maida)  1 tablespoon Red Chilli flakes , (adjust)  1 tablespoon Dried oregano  1 tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil Salt , to taste  1 cup Lukewarm Water , (adjust)  2 tablespoons Sesame seeds (Til seeds)  2 tablespoons Black sesame seeds
instructions: To make Crispy Lavash Recipe | Lebanese Bread (Eggless), Take a bowl or stand mixer, add salt, oregano, chilli flakes and olive oil, and mix everything well.Now add warm water little by little, and start kneading the dough till crumbly. Knead further.Once the dough comes together and soft enough, then cover it with a damp cloth and let it rest for 25 minutes.Preheat oven at 180 degree C.Divide the dough into 7 to 8 equal size balls.Dust one ball with flour and roll it into a circle as thin as possible.cut each circle into 5-6 triangles and sprinkle black and white sesame seeds on top.Arrange them on a greased baking tray and bake it for 10-12mins or until light brown and crisp.Take it out and let them cool.Serve Crispy Lavash Recipe | Lebanese Bread (Eggless) with Roasted Broccoli And Potato Dip Recipe or your favourite dip.

name: Instant Baked Aloo Tikki Recipe
description: Make this Instant Baked Aloo Tikki Recipe when unexpected guests come over or as a snack for kids. This recipe is really easy to make and is healthier than the traditionally deep fried ones since these are baked in oven. Most tikki recipes call for boiled ingredients to be mashed and then be shallow fried. But this recipe uses the grated potatoes directly without blanching or boiling them and hence makes the process faster.  Serve Instant Baked Aloo Tikki Recipe along with Dhaniya Pudina Chutney and tomato ketchup with a cup of hot Ginger Lemon Black Tea Recipe.
ingredients_name: Potatoes (Aloo),Spring Onion (Bulb & Greens),Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum),Whole Wheat Flour,Rice flour,Salt,Red Chilli powder,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 4 Potatoes (Aloo) , grated  2 Spring Onion (Bulb & Greens) , finely chopped  1 Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) , finely chopped  3 tablespoons Whole Wheat Flour , or maida  2 tablespoons Rice flour Salt , to taste  1 teaspoon Red Chilli powder Oil , to brush
instructions: To begin making Instant Baked Aloo Tikki Recipe, peel and grate potatoes. Chop all other required veggies.In a mixing bowl, add all the veggies, salt and squeeze so that the water oozes out. Now, add wheat and rice flour to bind the mixture. Add red chilli powder and mix well.Take 2 tablespoons of the mixture, make tikkis with your palms and put them on a baking tray lined with parchment sheet.Preheat the oven to 220 degrees Celsius. Lightly brush oil on the tikkis and bake for 10-20 minutes or till done and crisp..Serve Instant Baked Aloo Tikki Recipe along with Dhaniya Pudina Chutney and tomato ketchup with a cup of hot Ginger Lemon Black Tea Recipe.

name: Caribbean Vegetable Patties Recipe (Hand Pie)
description: Caribbean Vegetable Patties is a kind of savoury hand pies or our Indian savoury karanji or a kind of calzone. This was the first impression we got when we came across this recipe. These are basically half moon shaped with a crispy crust and stuffed with a spicy flavourful stuffing made from mixed veggies and aromatic Caribbean flavours. Instead of veggies one can stuff other non veg filling too.
ingredients_name: All Purpose Flour (Maida),Salt,Turmeric powder (Haldi),Curry powder,Butter (Salted),Chilled water,Mixed vegetables,Cabbage (Patta Gobi/ Muttaikose),Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum),Tomato,Onion,Ginger Garlic Paste,Salt,Coconut Oil,Paprika powder,All spice powder,Nutmeg powder,Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini)
ingredients_quantity: For the crust 2 cups All Purpose Flour (Maida)  1/2 teaspoon Salt  1/2 teaspoon Turmeric powder (Haldi)  1/2 teaspoon Curry powder  1/2 cup Butter (Salted) , adjustable   1/2 cup Chilled water For the stuffing  1 cup Mixed vegetables , (beans, carrot, corn) finely chopped  1/4 cup Cabbage (Patta Gobi/ Muttaikose) , chopped  1 Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) , chopped   1 Tomato , chopped  1 Onion , chopped  1 teaspoon Ginger Garlic Paste Salt , to tate  1 tablespoon Coconut Oil  1 teaspoon Paprika powder  1/2 teaspoon All spice powder Nutmeg powder , a pinch  Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini) , a pinch
instructions: To begin making the Caribbean Vegetable Patties recipe, for the crust, sift together flour, salt, turmeric and curry powder in a large bowl. Cut butter into small pieces and mix it into flour mixture till it is crumbly.Make a well in the centre and add water. Mix gently until a dough forms, then wrap dough in cling wrap and put in refrigerator for 1 hour.Meanwhile, make the filling. Heat oil in a skillet. Add onion, ginger, garlic, chopped vegetables and cook till they become soft.Add salt, all spice powder, nutmeg powder, cinnamon powder  and cook for a few more minutes. Remove from heat and let cool a little.To assemble patties, remove dough from refrigerator and divide into equal portionsRoll each piece into a 6-inch circle. Brush a little water around the edge of the circle and place about 2 to 3 tablespoons of filling in the middle. Fold in half and crimp the edges with a fork then gently pierce the centre with the fork to allow steam to escape. Apply butter on it.Once all patties are assembled, bake on a lightly oiled sheet pan at 215 degree for 25 minutes or until they're crisp. Serve hot.

name: Sindhi Kuneh Ja Bhee Recipe (Lotus Stem Chaat)
description: Sindhi Kuneh Ja Bhee Recipe (Lotus Stem Chaat) is a Sindhi special evening time recipe made using lotus stem. It’s like a chaat but a healthier version without involving any oil, or deep frying. So if you are in a mood for chaat, and looking out for healthy options, Kuneh ja bhee is just right for you. Lotus stem is very nutritious and a wonderful ingredient to cook with it. It’s kind of meaty and has an acquired taste. Sprinkled with chaat masala, green chutney, and sweet tamarind chutney it sure makes a delicious evening snack. If you haven’t tried lotus stem, then try this dish. You will appreciate the dish.
ingredients_name: Lotus Stem,Red Chilli powder,Cumin powder (Jeera),Chaat Masala Powder,Black pepper powder,Amchur (Dry Mango Powder),Salt,Onions,Coriander (Dhania) Leaves,Green Chutney (Coriander & Mint),Sweet Chutney (Date & Tamarind)
ingredients_quantity: 200 grams Lotus Stem  1 teaspoon Red Chilli powder  1/2 teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera)  1/2 teaspoon Chaat Masala Powder  1 teaspoon Black pepper powder  1/4 teaspoon Amchur (Dry Mango Powder) Salt , to taste  3 tablespoon Onions , finely chopped Coriander (Dhania) Leaves , a few, chopped  1 tablespoon Green Chutney (Coriander & Mint)  1/2 teaspoon Sweet Chutney (Date & Tamarind)
instructions: To begin making Sindhi Kuneh Ja Bhee Recipe (Lotus Stem Chaat), Wash lotus stem and peel the outside skin. Chop into 1 to 1-1/2 inch pieces.Add salt to taste, place the lotus stem in aluminum foil and cover it tight. Place this in a bowl and cover it with tight lid. Pressure cook for 45 minutes or till the stem is cooked completely.Once cooked remove from pressure cooker. Add all the seasoning(except for chaat masala and amchur powder) and toss it well.Place the seasoned lotus stem in a hot pan and just saute (without oil) on low flame for 5 minutes.Remove the stem into serving plate. Sprinkle finely chopped onions, fresh coriander leaves and some chaat masala and amchur masala.Drizzle some green chutney and sweet tamarind chutney. Serve immediately.Serve Sindhi Kuneh Ja Bhee Recipe (Lotus Stem Chaat) during evening with Sprouted Moong Chaat Recipe and Ginger Cardamom Chai (Spice Infused Indian Style Milk Tea).

name: Baked Banana Chips Recipe
description: We all love banana chips but people who are health conscious they avoid eating them because they are deep fried. But here is a delicious and a no fried recipe with Baked Banana Chips Recipe.This recipe is easy to make and tastes great. These can also be packed in the snack box for kids. Serve Baked Banana Chips Recipe along with Tomato and Sunflower Seed Dip Recipe or Coconut & Ricotta Dip with Banana Chips Recipe during tea time for snacking, along with a Smoothie or Masala Chai Recipe.
ingredients_name: Raw Banana,Paprika powder,Black pepper powder,Salt,Extra Virgin Olive Oil
ingredients_quantity: 3 Raw Banana , peeled and thinly sliced  1/2 tablespoon Paprika powder  1/4 tablespoon Black pepper powder Salt , to taste  1 tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil , to toss
instructions: To begin making Baked Banana Chips Recipe, take a bowl, add sliced banana, paprika powder, black pepper powder, salt to taste and a bit of olive oil to coat.Mix everything well and make sure that the banana slice gets coated well with oil and masala.Preheat the oven to 200 degree celcius for about 10 minutes. Meanwhile, spread coated banana slices over the baking sheet lined with a parchment paper.Bake at 200 degree celcius for 20-25 minutes or till they become crisp. Keep checking them as different oven takes different time to bake.Serve Baked Banana Chips Recipe along with Tomato and Sunflower Seed Dip Recipe or Coconut & Ricotta Dip with Banana Chips Recipe during tea time for snacking, along with a Smoothie or Masala Chai Recipe.

name: Savoury Baked Arbi Chips Recipe
description: Savoury Baked Arbi Chips Recipe is a delightful and a healthy way to indulge in chips since this recipe uses oven baking, instead of deep frying them. This is a great alternatively that can avoid the bags of ready to eat deep fried chips. Simple baking of the thin sliced arbi with olive oil and seasoning will yield a crunchy batch of chips to munch during a movie night with family or during evenings.
ingredients_name: Colocasia root (Arbi),Extra Virgin Olive Oil,Salt,Black pepper powder,Amchur (Dry Mango Powder)
ingredients_quantity: 6 Colocasia root (Arbi) , thinly sliced  1 tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil , to toss Salt , to taste Black pepper powder , to taste Amchur (Dry Mango Powder) , to taste (optional)
instructions: To begin making Savoury Baked Arbi Chips Recipe, pre heat oven at 400 F / 200 deg CMeanwhile wash, peel and thinly slice taro roots/arbi using a mandolin slicer. In a small bowl, mix olive oil, amchur (if using), salt and pepper. Rub this mixture into taro slices and toss well so that the spices and oil is coated on the arbi slices.Line a baking tray with a greased parchment paper. Spread chips evenly on the parchment paper. Take care that they do not overlap. Bake for 10-12 minutes. Take them out, toss and again place the baking tray in oven and bake at 160 deg centigrade for 4-5 minutes or ill crisp. Closely monitor the oven after a few minutes since each oven has different temperatures. Bake accordingly. Keep monitoring the recipe closely and bake accordingly.Crispy crunchy arbi chips ready to munch.Serve Savoury Baked Arbi Chips Recipe along with a dip like Tomato and Sunflower Seed Dip Recipe on a cloudy evening to family and kids.

name: Thotakura Undalu Recipe (Crispy Amaranth Leaves Balls)
description: Thotakura Undalu Recipe (Crispy Amaranth Leaves Balls) is an innovative recipe that is tried at our test kitchen. Amarnath leaves are usually used in a dry poriyal or subzi. But in this dish we have created a crispy fried amaranth balls and then tossed with some tempered spices. Amarnath leaves is a powerhouse of Iron, minerals and vitamins. It is considered as one of the super food and Ayurvedic friendly as well.
ingredients_name: Green Amaranth Leaves,Gram flour (besan),Cumin seeds (Jeera),Red Chilli powder,Ginger,Salt,Oil,Sesame seeds (Til seeds),Curry leaves,Asafoetida (hing),Dry Red Chillies
ingredients_quantity: 2 cups Green Amaranth Leaves , chopped  4 tablespoons Gram flour (besan)  1 teaspoon Cumin seeds (Jeera)  1 teaspoon Red Chilli powder  1 inch Ginger , chopped Salt , to taste Oil To temper 2 teaspoon Sesame seeds (Til seeds)  1 sprig Curry leaves  1 pinch Asafoetida (hing)  2 Dry Red Chillies
instructions: To begin making the Thotakura Undalu Recipe, add chopped amaranth leaves in a bowl add all the ingredients mentioned next.Add little water and mix to form stick mixture. Using your hand take little of the mixture and hold it tightly to form a ball. Do the same for the rest of the mixture.Heat a kuzhi paniyaram pan with oil. Once it is hot place the balls in each cavity and fry them till they become crispy.Take them out and drain oil over a paper napkin. Heat a flat skillet with oil, Add sesame seeds and curry leaves and allow them to splutter for few seconds.Add dry red chilies and hing, let them crackle for 2 seconds, add fried amaranth balls and coat the the tempering well and serve hot.Serve the Thotakura Undalu Recipe along with Thakkali Rasam Recipe , steamed rice and Carrot Poriyal Recipe or just plain with Thakkali sadam.

name: सुखी आलू बैंगन की सब्ज़ी रेसिपी - South Indian Potato and Eggplant Sabzi (Recipe In Hindi
description: सुखी आलू बैंगन की सब्ज़ी को अलग अलग राज्य में अलग अलग तरीके से बनाया जाता है. यह आलू बैंगन सब्ज़ी दक्षिण भारत स्टाइल में बनाई गई है. इसमें हींग, कढ़ी पत्ता, सुखी लाल मिर्च का प्रयोग होता है जो इसको और भी स्वादिष्ट बनाता है.
ingredients_name: Potato,Eggplant,Mustard Seeds,Asafoetida,Turmeric Powder,Salt,Red Chili Powder,Curry Leaves,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 4 आलू , उबाल ले, छीलकर काट ले  1 बैंगन  1 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1/4 हींग , + 1/4 छोटा चमच्च  1/2 हल्दी पाउडर , + 1/2 छोटा चमच्च नमक , स्वाद अनुसार लाल मिर्च पाउडर , स्वाद अनुसार  1 टहनी कढ़ी पत्ता तेल , प्रयोग अनुसार
instructions: सुखी आलू बैंगन की सब्ज़ी बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले आलू को एक प्रेशर कुकर में पानी और नमक के साथ डाले। 3 सिटी आने तक पकाए। गैस बंद करें और प्रेशर अपने आप निकलने दे. छिलका निकले और काट ले. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें राइ डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स तक पकने दे. अब इसमें आलू, नमक, हींग, लाल मिर्च पाउडर और हल्दी पाउडर डाले। आलू के सुनहरा होने तक पकाए। अलग से रख दे.उसी कढ़ाई में थोड़ा और तेल डाले। इसमें कढ़ी पत्ता और बैंगन डाले। 1 मिनट बाद नमक, लाल मिर्च पाउडर, हींग और हल्दी पाउडर डाले। कढ़ाई को ढक ले और बैंगन के नरम होने तक पकाए। अब इसमें आलू डाले और 2 मिनट तक पकने दे. गैस बंद करें और गरमा गरम परोसे। सुखी आलू बैंगन को दाल तड़का और तवा पराठा के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे.

name: Bitter gourd masala vegetable recipe - Karela Masala Sabzi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Karela Masala is a simple recipe in which bitter gourd is cooked with everyday spices. This bitter gourd is steamed and cooked with everyday spices.
ingredients_name: Bitter Gourd,Onion,Garlic,Ginger,Tomato,Turmeric Powder,Dried Mango Powder,Garam Masala Powder,Coriander Powder,Salt,Red Chili Powder,Jaggery,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 3 bitter gourd, seeds removed and thinly sliced ​​1 onion, thinly sliced ​​2 cloves garlic, grated 1 inch ginger, grated 2 tomatoes, finely chopped 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1 teaspoon dried mango powder 1 teaspoon garam masala powder 1 teaspoon coriander powder Salt, to taste Red chilli powder, to taste 1 teaspoon jaggery or sugar Oil, as needed
instructions: To make Karela Masala Sabzi, first put bitter gourd in a pressure cooker along with 2 or 3 tbsp water, salt and turmeric powder. Mix well and cook till 1 whistle. Turn off the gas and put it under cold water to release the pressure. Now heat oil in a pan. Add onion, ginger and garlic in it. Cook till the onion becomes soft. After the onion becomes soft, add tomatoes along with turmeric powder, dry mango powder, red chili powder, salt, garam masala powder and coriander powder. Cook till the tomatoes become soft. After the tomatoes become soft, add cooked bitter gourd in it and cover the pan. Let it cook for 10 minutes. Turn off the gas and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve Karela Masala with Rajasthani Kadhi and Phulkas for lunch.

name: Pina Colada Cake Recipe
description: Pina Colada Cake Recipe is a yummy juicy cake with chunks of pineapple inside and with a nutty coconut flavour to it. This creamy cake is good to go for birthday parties as well. Try this unique tasty cake recipe for a special occasion at home. Ready in under an hour, this is a perfect cake when you have guests coming home for the evening.
ingredients_name: Vivatta Maida,Milk,Oil,Butter (Unsalted),Sugar,Baking powder,Baking soda,Dry coconut (kopra),Rum,Pineapple,Butter (Unsalted),Caster Sugar,Coconut milk
ingredients_quantity: For the cake 2 cups Vivatta Maida  3/4 cup Milk  1/2 cup Oil  1/2 cup Butter (Unsalted)  1-1/2 cups Sugar  1/2 teaspoon Baking powder  1 pinch Baking soda  1 cup Dry coconut (kopra) , shredded  2 teaspoons Rum , (coconut rum - optional)  1 Pineapple , sliced to chunks For the frosting 1 cup Butter (Unsalted) , softened  2 cups Caster Sugar  2 tablespoons Coconut milk
instructions: To begin making Pina Colada Cake Recipe, in a large bowl, mix the butter and sugar well with the help of a hand mixer.To this, add the flour, baking soda, baking powder and mix well. Then add milk, oil and pineapple chunks and 1/2 cup of shredded and toasted coconut. Add a teaspoon of coconut rum if desired and mix evenly.Preheat oven at 325 degrees F for about 10 minutes.Meanwhile grease two 8 inch pans (any pan of your choice) and pour the cake batter into them after greasing them with a little butter.Bake in oven for 25 minutes or more till the toothpick inserted in the middle of the pan comes out clean. Take the pans out and cool on a wire rack.Meanwhile for the frosting, beat the butter till it becomes light in a blender. Add sugar, coconut milk to the butter and mix well to achieve a creamy texture.Take the cakes out of the pans. On a plate, first keep a cake and apply frosting all over the cake. Arrange four pineapple slices and also add the toasted coconut all over.Keep the other cake on top of this carefully. Apply the frosting again all over the other cake and cover both of them completely with the frosting.Spread the toasted coconut all over the cake carefully. Arrange the remaining pineapple slices as shown in the picture or can be done of your own choice.Refrigerate for at least 2 to 3 hours before serving. Serve Pina Colada Cake Recipe with Samosa Recipe, Cold Coffee Smoothie Recipe and more tea time snacks.

name: Keerai Masiyal Recipe – Keerai Masiyal (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Keerai Masiyal is a simple recipe in which you can use any green vegetable. This dish is prepared in every South Indian household and served for lunch or dinner. Cumin, mustard seeds, curry leaves and asafoetida are used in it, which enhances its taste.
ingredients_name: Spinach,Amaranth Leaves,Cumin,Mustard Seeds,White Urad Dal,Curry Leaves,Asafoetida,Salt,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 500 gms spinach, chopped Amaranth leaves, chopped 1/2 tsp cumin seeds 1/2 tsp mustard seeds 1 tsp white urad dal 1 sprig curry leaves Asafoetida, pinch Salt, to taste 1 tsp oil
instructions: To make Keerai Masiyal, first put amaranth and spinach in a pressure cooker along with 1 tbsp water and salt. Cook till 1 whistle and then place the cooker under cold water to release the pressure. Keep it aside. Now heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, asafoetida and let it cook for 30 seconds. Now add spinach and amaranth and let it cook for 1 minute. After 1 minute, turn off the gas and serve hot. Serve Keerai Masiyal with Tomato Onion Sambar and Rice for lunch.

name: Karamani Poriyal Recipe – Karamani Poriyal (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Karamani Poriyal is a South Indian recipe which is very healthy. Red chillies are used in the seasoning which enhances its taste even more.
ingredients_name: Lobia Pods,Coconut,Turmeric Powder,Mustard Seeds,White Urad Dal,Asafoetida,Oil,Curry Leaves,Salt,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 300 grams black eyed beans, chopped 2 tablespoons coconut, grated 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder 1 teaspoon mustard seeds 1 teaspoon white urad dal 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida 1 teaspoon oil 6 curry leaves Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Karamani Poriyal, first cut the black eyed peas. Now put coconut in a mixer grinder and grind it. You can also add red chilli powder in it. Now heat oil in a pan. Now add mustard seeds and let it cook for 10 seconds. Now add urad dal and cook till it turns golden. Now add curry leaves, asafoetida and let it cook for 15 seconds. Now add black eyed peas. Add salt and cook till the black eyed peas are cooked. Take it out in a bowl and garnish with grated coconut and chilli powder. Serve Karamani Poriyal with Mixed Vegetable Sambar and Rice for lunch.

name: Besan Burji Recipe – Besan Burji (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Besan Bhurji is a very simple dish which you can make when you run out of vegetables in your fridge. We usually make Bhurji with eggs but here we will use Bhurji instead of eggs. You can also add vegetables of your choice in this Bhurji.
ingredients_name: Besan,Flax Seeds Powder,Yogurt,Cumin,Onion,Green Bell Pepper,Button Mushroom,Green Chilli,Turmeric Powder,Red Chili Powder,Cumin Powder,Salt,Coriander Leaves,Coriander (Dhania) Leaves
ingredients_quantity: For the batter 1 cup gram flour 1 tbsp flax seeds powder 2 tbsp curd 1 tsp cumin seeds 1 onion , finely chopped 1 capsicum (green) , finely chopped 1 cup button mushrooms , thinly sliced ​​2 green chillies , finely chopped 1/4 tsp turmeric powder 1 tsp red chilli powder 1 tsp cumin seeds powder Salt , to taste 2 sprigs coriander leaves , finely chopped 2 sprig Coriander (Dhania) Leaves , finely chopped
instructions: To make Besan Bhurji, first keep the mixture ready. In a bowl add gram flour, flax seeds powder and curd. Mix it well. Now heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and onion and cook till the onion becomes soft. Now add capsicum, mushroom and green chillies. After 2 minutes add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, cumin powder, salt and let it cook for 2 minutes. Now slowly add gram flour solution to it. Reduce the flame and let it cook for 5 minutes. Mix everything well. Cook till you get the texture of Bhurji. Now add coriander leaves and mix it. Serve Besan Bhurji with bread toast and filter coffee for breakfast or with Tawa Paratha and Boondi Raita for lunch.

name: Vegetable Uttapam Recipe – Vegetable Uttapam (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Uttapam is a famous breakfast recipe from South India. It is slightly thicker than dosa and is served with chutney and sambar. You can make different types of uttapam. You can add tomatoes, onions or any vegetable to the uttapam.
ingredients_name: Idli Dosa Mix,Onion,Green Bell Pepper,Carrot,Tomato,Green Chilli,Coriander Leaves,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup idli dosa mixture 1/4 cup onion, finely chopped 1/4 cup capsicum (green), finely chopped 1/4 cup carrot, finely chopped 1 tomato, finely chopped 2 green chillies, finely chopped 2 tbsp coriander leaves, finely chopped Oil, as needed
instructions: To make Vegetable Uttapam, first take the dosa mixture in a bowl. Chop all the vegetables finely and keep them aside. Now grease a non-stick pan and apply some oil. After the oil is heated, pour the Idli Dosa mixture in the centre of the pan and make round uttapam. Keep it a little thick. Add all the chopped vegetables one by one on top, pour some oil on the sides. Let it cook from the bottom. After a while, flip the uttapam. Pour some oil and let it cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Serve hot. Serve Vegetable Uttapam with Mixed Vegetable Sambar and Coconut Chutney for breakfast.

name: Peanut Butter Cookies Recipe
description: Its that time of the year when we start putting are mittens on and bake our heart out. Today am sharing a perfect peanut butter cookie recipe.Those who love peanut butter these cookies will be a pleasure for them. I am not a big fan of peanut butter but have turned to be a fan of peanut butter in form of cookies.These cookies are packed with the flavor of peanut butter and the soft texture will make you gobble 2-3 cookies at a time.They go well with your cup of tea or as it is.The texture is similar to the butter biscuits with peanut butter flavor is the only difference. These are perfect treats to go for your Christmas goodies. With no further ado lets move to one of my secret recipe.
ingredients_name: Vivatta Maida,Baking powder,Peanut Butter,Vanilla Extract,Icing Sugar,Butter (Unsalted)
ingredients_quantity: 1-3/4 cup Vivatta Maida  1/2 teaspoon Baking powder  1 cup Peanut Butter , Smooth Vanilla Extract , Few drops  1 cup Icing Sugar  3/4 cup Butter (Unsalted) , softened
instructions: To begin making the Peanut Butter Cookies recipe, Pre-heat the oven at 350 F for 15 minutes.In a large bowl, add unsalted butter and peanut butter. Mix them well, an once it is mixed properly add sugar to it. Mix them again till the mixture turn creamy. Next, add vanilla essence to it. Sieve all purpose flour and baking powder in to the creamed butter mixer. Mix them slowly and form a dough.Divide the dough to equal parts and roll each of them to balls. Flatten each ball slightly by pressing it between palm and give some design using a fork or a cookie press if you have one. Place the shaped and designed cookie on a cookie tray lined with parchment paper.Bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 350 F. Check and bake till the cookies are light brown. Once baked let them sit on the tray for 10 to 15 mins again, after they cool transfer them to a wire rack and let them cool completely. Once they are done cooling transfer them to an air tight container and enjoy.Serve Peanut Butter Cookies along with Masala Mixed Sprouts Sandwich and Masala Chai for your tea time snack.

name: Matar Ka Cheela Recipe – Matar Ka Cheela (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Peas Cheela is a delicious breakfast dish that is made in North India. In this Cheela, everyday spices are also used along with peas, which further enhances its taste.
ingredients_name: Green Peas,Besan,Rice Flour,Paneer,Cream,Ginger,Baking Soda,Red Chili Powder,Cumin Powder,Salt,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup green peas, boiled 2 tbsp gram flour 2 tbsp rice flour 2 tbsp paneer, grated 1 tbsp cream 1 tsp ginger, grated 1/2 tsp cooking soda 1/2 tsp red chilli powder 1/2 tsp cumin powder 1/2 tsp salt 2 tsp oil, as required
instructions: To make Matar ka Cheela, first boil the peas. Put it in a mixer grinder with some water and make a paste. Put this paste in a bowl along with all the other ingredients. Do not add oil. Mix the mixture well. Now heat a non-stick pan. Put some oil in it. After the oil is heated, remove it with a paper napkin. Now put some pea mixture in the centre of the pan. Now spread it in the middle in a round shape like a pancake with the help of a spoon. Pour some oil on the sides and cook till it is cooked from both the sides. Serve Matar ka Cheela with Coriander Mint Chutney and ginger tea for breakfast.

name: टमाटर मटर पोहा रेसिपी - Tomato Poha With Peas (Recipe In Hindi)
description: पोहा एक बहुत ही प्रसिद्ध नाश्ते की रेसिपी है जो उत्तर भारत के हर घर में बनाई जाती है. इसमें आयरन की मात्रा अधिक होती है इसलिए यह आपके सेहत के लिए भी अच्छा माना जाता है. यह लाइट है और नाश्ते के लिए एक दम पर्याप्त है. इस पोहे में टमाटर भी डाला जाता है जो इसको एक अलग ट्विस्ट देता है.
ingredients_name: Poha,Green Peas,Onion,Tomato,Green Chilli,Garlic,Fennel Seeds,Mustard Seeds,Asafoetida,Turmeric Powder,Red Chili Powder,Coriander Powder,Curry Leaves,Coriander Leaves,Oil,Lemon Juice,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 2 कप पोहा  1/2 कप हरे मटर , गरम पानी में 5 मिनट के लिए डाल दे  1 प्याज , बारीक काट ले  3 टमाटर , बारीक काट ले  1 हरी मिर्च , बारीक काट ले  2 कली लहसुन  1 छोटा चमच्च सौंफ  1 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1/4 छोटा चमच्च हींग  1/2 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर  1 छोटा चमच्च लाल मिर्च पाउडर  1 छोटा चमच्च धनिया पाउडर  1 टहनी कढ़ी पत्ता  2 बड़े चमच्च हरा धनिया , बारीक काट ले (गार्निश के लिए)  2 छोटा चमच्च तेल  2 छोटा चमच्च निम्बू का रस नमक , स्वाद अनुसार
instructions: टमाटर मटर पोहा बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले पोहा को अच्छी तरह से धो ले. 2 से 3 बार धोने के बाद, पानी पूरा निकाल ले और अलग से रख दे.अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें राइ डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स तक पकने दे. अब एक हमनदस्ते में सौंफ और लहसुन डाले। कदूकस कर ले और इसे कढ़ाई में डाल दे. लहसुन के सुनहरा होने तक पकाए। अब इसमें हींग, कढ़ी पत्ता डाले। 10 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसमें प्याज डाले और उसके नरम होने तक पकाए। प्याज के नरम होने के बाद इसमें टमाटर, हरी मिर्च डाले और टमाटर के नरम होने तक पकने दे. अब इसमें हल्दी पाउडर, लाल मिर्च पाउडर और धनिया पाउडर डाले। 1 मिनट तक पकने दे. अब इसमें पोहा, नमक डाले और सब कुछ मिला ले. कढ़ाई को ढके और 10 मिनट तक पकने दे. पकने के बाद, गैस बंद करें और हरे धनिये से गार्निश करें। टमाटर मटर पोहा को मसाला चाय और फ्रूट बाउल के साथ सुबह के नाश्ते के लिए परोसे.

name: Jeera Aloo Sabzi Recipe – Jeera Aloo Sabzi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Jeera Aloo Sabzi is a simple dry vegetable recipe that you can quickly make for your everyday meal. In this, potatoes are cooked with cumin seeds and the spiciness comes from green chillies.
ingredients_name: Potato,Green Chilli,Turmeric Powder,Cumin,Salt,Curry Leaves,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 3 potatoes, boiled, peeled and chopped 2 green chillies 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1 teaspoon cumin seeds Salt, to taste 1 sprig curry leaves, chopped Oil, as needed
instructions: To make Jeera Aloo Sabzi, first heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and green chillies and let it cook for 15 seconds. After that add potatoes, turmeric powder and curry leaves. Add salt and cook till the potatoes turn golden brown. Add green chillies and lemon juice and mix. Serve hot. Serve Jeera Aloo Sabzi with Daal Palak and Phulkas for lunch.

name: Cluster bean dry vegetable recipe - Cluster bean dry vegetable recipe (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Cluster bean Sukhi Sabzi is a Rajasthani recipe where cluster bean is cooked with common spices. You can also add coconut, jaggery and tomatoes to it. It is a simple dish which can be packed in your lunch box. It is made in every Rajasthani household and served with parathas or phulkas.
ingredients_name: Onion,Cluster Beans,Cumin,Garlic,Oil,Turmeric Powder,Coriander Powder,Cumin Powder,Red Chili Powder,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 onion, finely chopped 1-1/2 cups cluster beans, small chopped 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds 1/2 teaspoon garlic, grated Oil, as needed 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder 1 teaspoon coriander powder 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder 1 teaspoon red chilli powder Salt, as needed
instructions: To make Cluster bean Sukhi Sabzi, first heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let it cook for 10 seconds. Now add garlic and cook for 1 minute. After 1 minute add onions and cook till the onions become soft. Now add cluster bean and 1/2 cup water. After it is half cooked, add coriander powder, red chili powder, cumin powder and salt. Mix and cook till the cluster bean is cooked well. Serve Cluster bean Sukhi Sabzi with Rabodi ki Sabzi and Phulkas for lunch.

name: Broccoli and Pepper Rice Recipe – Broccoli and Pepper Rice (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Broccoli and Pepper Rice is a simple and healthy recipe that also uses raisins and cashews. It is a perfect recipe for those days when you want to eat something tasty but want to make something that takes less time. You can also pack it in your kids' lunch boxes.
ingredients_name: Rice,Broccoli,Green Bell Pepper,Red Bell Pepper,Onion,Green Chilli,Garlic,Lemon Juice,Coriander Leaves,Black Pepper Powder,Salt,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 1 rice 1/2 cup broccoli, finely chopped 1 capsicum (green), finely chopped 1 capsicum (red), finely chopped 1 onion, finely chopped 2 green chillies, finely chopped 3 cloves garlic, finely chopped 2 tbsp lemon juice Coriander leaves, finely chopped (a little) 2 tsp black pepper powder Salt, to taste 1 tbsp oil
instructions: To make Broccoli and Pepper Rice, first cook the rice. In a saucepan, add rice along with 2 cups of water, salt, oil, lemon juice. Cook till the rice is cooked. After cooking, cover and keep aside to cool. Now heat oil in a pan. Add onion, green chilies, capsicum and cook till the capsicum becomes soft. After the capsicum is cooked, add broccoli and mix it well. Cook till the broccoli becomes soft. Now add cooked rice, black pepper powder, salt and coriander leaves. Mix, cook for 2 more minutes and serve hot. Serve Broccoli and Pepper Rice with Cucumber and Chilli Raita for dinner.

name: मशरुम मेथी ब्राउन राइस रेसिपी - Mushroom Methi Brown Rice (Recipe In Hindi)
description: मशरुम मेथी ब्राउन राइस एक स्वादिष्ठ पुलाव की रेसिपी है जो सिर्फ स्वादिष्ट ही नहीं सेहतमंद भी है. मशरुम और मेथी को डालने से इसका स्वाद और भी बढ़ जाता है. आप इस पुलाव को सुबह अपने या अपने बच्चो के लंच बॉक्स में भी पैक कर सकते है. इस रेसिपी को एक बार बनाए और हमे विश्वास है की आपके बच्चो को यह जरूर पसंद आएगी।
ingredients_name: Brown Rice,Button Mushroom,Fenugreek,Onion,Tomato,Green Chilli,Garlic,Red Chili Powder,Coriander Powder,Turmeric Powder,Salt,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 1 कप ब्राउन राइस  1 कप बटन मशरुम , पतला काट ले  1 कप मेथी , काट ले  2 प्याज , बारीक काट ले  2 टमाटर , बारीक काट ले  3 हरी मिर्च , काट ले  5 कली लहसुन , काट ले  1 छोटा चमच्च लाल मिर्च पाउडर  2 छोटा चमच्च धनिया पाउडर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर नमक , स्वाद अनुसार  2 बड़े चमच्च तेल
instructions: मशरुम मेथी ब्राउन राइस बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले ब्राउन राइस को धो कर 30 मिनट के लिए भिगो दे. इसमें से पानी निकाल ले और ब्राउन राइस को कुकर में डाल दे. इसमें 2-1/2 कप पानी डाले और 2 सिटी आने तक पका ले.अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें लहसुन डाले और 1 मिनट तक पका ले. अब इसमें प्याज, हरी मिर्च डाले और प्याज के नरम होने तक पकाए। प्याज के नरम होने के बाद इसमें टमाटर डाले और टमाटर के नरम होने तक पकाए। अब इसमें लाल मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर, धनिया पाउडर और नमक डाले। 2 मिनट के लिए पकने दे. अब मशरुम डाले, मिलाए और अगले 2 से 3 मिनट तक पकने दे. अब इसमें मेथी डाले और अगले 3 मिनट तक पकाए। मशरुम और मेथी के पक जाने के बाद, इसमें पके हुए ब्राउन राइस डाले और मिला ले. स्वाद अनुसार नमक डाले और परोसे। मशरुम मेथी ब्राउन राइस को टमाटर ककड़ी प्याज का रायता और पापड़ के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: एल्लु चटनी रेसिपी - Sesame Seeds Chutney (Recipe In Hindi)
description: एल्लु चटनी दक्षिण भारत की एक प्रसिद्ध चटनी है जिसे इडली या डोसे के साथ परोसा जाता है. इसको ज्यादातर काले तिल से बनाया जाता है. यह बनाने में आसान है और आप इसे अपने नाश्ते में भी परोस सकते है.
ingredients_name: Black Sesame Seeds,White Urad Dal,Coconut,Dried Red Chilli,Curry Leaves,Tamarind,Salt,Oil,Oil,Mustard Seeds,Curry Leaves
ingredients_quantity: 3 बड़े चमच्च काले तिल  1 बड़ा चमच्च सफ़ेद उरद दाल  3 बड़े चमच्च नारियल , कस ले  5 सुखी लाल मिर्च कढ़ी पत्ता , थोड़े इमली , छोटी नमक , स्वाद अनुसार  1 छोटा चमच्च तेल , प्रयोग अनुसार तड़के के लिए 1 छोटा चमच्च तेल  1/2 छोटा चमच्च राइ कढ़ी पत्ता , थोड़े
instructions: एल्लु चटनी को बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले इमली को थोड़े पानी में भिगो ले. अब एक कढ़ाई गरम करें और उसमे काले तिल डाले। मध्यम आंच पर रोस्ट करते रहे. रोस्ट हो जाने के बाद अलग से निकाल कर रख दे. अब उसी कढ़ाई में 1 छोटा चमच्च तेल गरम करें। इसमें उरद दाल, सुखी लाल मिर्च और कढ़ी पत्ता डाले, दाल के सुनहरा होने तक पकाए। गैस बंद कर ले. अब एक मिक्सर ग्राइंडर में काले तिल, इमली पानी के साथ, लाल मिर्च और दाल का मिश्रण और नमक डाले। गाढ़ा पेस्ट बनाने तक पीस ले. इस चटनी को एक बाउल में निकाल ले. अब एक तड़का पैन में तेल गरम करें। इसमें राइ डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स तक पकने दे. 10 सेकण्ड्स के बाद इसमें कढ़ी पत्ता डाले। 5 सेकण्ड्स के बाद इस तड़के को चटनी में डाले और मिला ले. परोसे। एल्लु चटनी को मिक्स्ड वेजिटेबल सांबर, चावल और चाउ चाउ थोरन के साथ परोसे।

name: Thabdi Peda Recipe – Thabdi Peda (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Thabadi Penda is a famous sweet of Gujarat Kathiawar. This Penda is made from milk and sugar. It is very easy and takes less time to make. You can eat it in two ways. If served hot, you can eat it as Thabadi and if you shape it, you can eat it like Penda. Do make Thabadi Penda on festivals and as Bhog Prasad.
ingredients_name: Milk,Sugar,Ghee,Alum,Cardamom Powder,Glucose
ingredients_quantity: 2 cups milk 3 tablespoons sugar 1 tablespoon ghee 1 alum 1 teaspoon cardamom powder 1 teaspoon glucose, liquid
instructions: To make Thabadi Penda, first boil milk in a pan, add 1 small piece of alum and let the milk curdle. In another pan melt 3 tablespoons of sugar. Once the sugar melts turn off the gas immediately. Mix the melted sugar with the curdled milk. Keep stirring for 2 minutes. Now add 1 tablespoon of ghee. Add 1 spoon of liquid glucose. Add 1 spoon of cardamom powder. Keep stirring and cook the mixture till it releases ghee. Remove from the flame and take it out in a plate. You can serve this Thabadi hot like this also and let the Thabadi cool down a bit for making Penda. Then make Pedas. Garnish with pistachios. Store in a closed box. Serve Thabadi Penda as Prasad or as a sweet after the meal.

name: Cauliflower Vegetable Recipe - Phool Gobi Sabzi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Cauliflower vegetable is a delicious vegetable in which everyday spices are used. Its taste increases a lot by adding a little spices. You can also pack this vegetable in your or your children's lunch box.
ingredients_name: Cauliflower,Tomato,Ginger,Cumin,Turmeric Powder,Garam Masala Powder,Salt,Coriander Leaves,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 1 cabbage, chopped 2 tomatoes, pureed 1 inch ginger, grated 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1-1/2 teaspoons garam masala powder Salt, to taste 4 sprigs coriander leaves, chopped Oil, as needed
instructions: To make Cauliflower Sabzi, first heat oil in a pan. Add ginger, cumin seeds and let it cook for 15 seconds. After 15 seconds add tomatoes, turmeric powder, garam masala powder, salt, mix it and let it cook for 1 minute. Now add cauliflower, 2 tbsp water, mix it and cover the pan. Reduce the flame and let it cook for 10 to 15 minutes. After the cauliflower is cooked, turn off the gas and garnish it with coriander leaves. Serve Cauliflower Sabzi with Mint Moong Daal, Boondi Raita and Phulkas for lunch.

name: Aloo Palak Sabzi Recipe - Aloo Palak Sabzi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Aloo palak sabzi is a simple dish made with boiled potatoes, spinach and cinnamon. It is easy to make so you can make it for your busy days and pack it in your lunch box.
ingredients_name: Potato,Spinach,Onion,Tomato,Red Chili Powder,Turmeric Powder,Ginger,Cinnamon Powder,Garam Masala Powder,Cumin,Oil,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 3 potatoes, boiled, peeled and chopped 500 grams spinach, washed and chopped 1 onion, thinly sliced ​​2 tomatoes, finely chopped 1 teaspoon red chilli powder 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1 inch ginger, grated 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon powder 1/4 teaspoon garam masala powder 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds Oil, as needed Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Aloo Palak Sabzi, first heat oil in a pan. Add spinach, some salt and cook till the spinach becomes soft. Keep it aside after it is cooked. Heat some more oil in it. Add cumin seeds, ginger, onion and cook till the onion turns golden. After it turns golden, add potatoes, salt and cook till the potatoes turn golden. Now add tomatoes, turmeric powder, red chili powder, cinnamon powder, garam masala powder and salt. Mix it. After it cooks for 2 to 3 minutes, add spinach. Cover the pan and cook for another 3 minutes. Turn off the gas and serve. Serve Aloo Palak Sabzi with Gujarati Daal and Phulkas for lunch.

name: Goan Style Bebinca/ Bebik/ Bebinka Recipe
description: Goan Style Bebinca/bibik/bebinka Recipe is almost loved recipe by most of the Goans. It is a type of layered pudding that is usually layered with two different colors of coconut milk and maida batter. To one they usually add malt sugar, date syrup or even coffee liqueur to differentiate the different layers. A traditional bebinca has seven layers. The sweet is generally prepared during the Christmas festival and it can be preserved for a longer time and eaten cold as well.
ingredients_name: Coconut milk,Vivatta Maida,Whole Eggs,Confectioners sugar,Date syrup,Nutmeg,Vanilla Extract,Ghee,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 300 ml Coconut milk  120 grams Vivatta Maida  2 Whole Eggs  3 teaspoons Confectioners sugar  1 tablespoon Date syrup  1/4 teaspoon Nutmeg  1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract  1/4 cup Ghee Salt , a pinch
instructions: To begin making the Goan Style Bebinca/bibik/bebinka Recipe, we will first preheat the oven to 180 degree Celsius for 10 minutes, You add coconut milk to mixing bowl.Add flour and whisk till there are no lumps formed. Break two eggs into the batter as well, add nutmeg, vanilla essence as well and whisk till there are no lumps formed.Now equally spate the batter into two bowls, to one bowl add date syrup and whisk to form a light brown batter.To another batter add refined sugar and whisk well till the sugar incorporates.Take a baking dish, add 2 teaspoon of hot melted ghee over it, and pour 2 ladle of white batter first and bate for 5 minutes till the batter hardens.Take it out and sprinkle 2 more teaspoon of ghee and add 2 ladle of brown batter and bake it again in the oven for another 5 minutes.Continue the process of adding ghee and changing the batter till you finish all the batter and it has reached the brim.Once the last layer is over, allow it cool it outside for few minutes, flip it over and cut into small pieces and serve warm.Serve the Goan Style Bebinca/bibik/bebinka along with a scoop of ice cream along with a cup of Masala Chai Recipe to make your evening special.

name: Uttaranchal Style Garwhali Kafuli Recipe (Spinach Curry)
description: Uttaranchal Style Garwhali Kafuli Recipe (Spinach Curry) is a dish that has been from the hilly region of Uttaranchal. Their cooking and food are simple to suit the harsh weather in hilly regions. Most of them prefer to vegetarian food.  In this recipe, spinach and fenugreek leaves are cooked till soft and blitzed to form a smooth paste and then cooked along with Indian spice and thickened with rice flour. The dish is very simple and does not contain any vegetable. The dish shoes how the simplicity of the Pahadi cooking.
ingredients_name: Spinach Leaves (Palak),Methi Leaves (Fenugreek Leaves),Green Chilli,Ginger,Cumin powder (Jeera),Turmeric powder (Haldi),Coriander Powder (Dhania),Asafoetida (hing),Rice flour,Curd (Dahi / Yogurt),Salt,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 2 cups Spinach Leaves (Palak)  1 cup Methi Leaves (Fenugreek Leaves)  2 Green Chilli , chopped  1 inch Ginger , chopped  1 teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera)  1/2 teaspoon Turmeric powder (Haldi)  1 teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)  1 pinch Asafoetida (hing)  1 tablespoon Rice flour  1/4 cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt) Salt , to taste Oil
instructions: To begin making the Uttaranchal Style Garwhali Kafuli Recipe, wash the spinach leaves and fenugreek leaves and chop them.Add the leaves along with green chilli, salt and little bit of water and pressure cook for about 2 whistle till done.Allow the pressure to release naturally and cool the leaves for some time and blitz it in the grinder till it forms a smooth paste.Heat a kadai with oil, add ginger allow it soften. Add ground spinach paste and keep stirring.You can also add in spice powder and salt and give a stir. In a separate bowl mix rice flour with 1/2 cup of water and stir in into the gravy mixture.Also add in the beaten curd and keep stirring until the gravy thickens. Check for salt and garnish it with ginger. Serve the Uttaranchal Style Garwhali Kafuli Recipe along with a Baby corn and Carrot Subzi and Missi Roti by the side to make it a complete meal.

name: Kala Desi Chana Recipe – Kala Desi Chana (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Kala Desi Chana is a delicious, spicy and flavourful recipe which does not use onion and garlic. It is very easy to make and you can make it for guests at your home as well.
ingredients_name: Black Chickpeas,Cumin,Ginger,Turmeric Powder,Red Chili Powder,Garam Masala Powder,Coriander Powder,Oil,Salt,Coriander Leaves,Coriander (Dhania) Leaves
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup kala chana 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 1 inch ginger , peeled and grated 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1 teaspoon red chilli powder 1 teaspoon garam masala powder 1 teaspoon coriander powder 2 tablespoons oil Salt, to taste 4 sprigs coriander (Dhania) Leaves , roughly chopped for garnish
instructions: To make Kala Desi Chana, first soak the chickpeas in 2 cups of water for 6 hours. Then drain the water. Now put them in a pressure cooker along with 2-1/2 cups of water. Cook till 4 whistles, turn off the gas and let the pressure release on its own. Keep it aside. Now heat oil in a saucepan. Add cumin seeds and let it cook for 15 seconds. Now add ginger and let it cook for 10 seconds. After that add turmeric powder, coriander powder, garam masala, red chilli powder, salt and chickpeas. Mix it. Mix it and let it cook. After it boils, reduce the flame and let it cook for 20 to 30 minutes. After cooking, garnish with coriander leaves and serve. Serve Kala Desi Chana with Puri and Boondi Raita for lunch.

name: Green Moong Dal Makhani Recipe – Green Moong Dal Makhani (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Green Moong Dal Makhani is a delicious dal which is made in every dhaba. All the Indian spices are added to it and the cream enhances its taste even more. You can make this dal even when you have guests at home.
ingredients_name: Green Moong Dal,Tomato,Ginger,Green Chilli,Turmeric Powder,Cumin Powder,Whole Black Pepper,Cardamom Powder,Oil,Cream,Coriander Leaves,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup green moong dal 1 tomato, puree 1 inch ginger, grated 2 green chillies, finely chopped 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder 1 teaspoon whole black pepper, crushed 1 teaspoon cardamom powder 1 teaspoon oil 1/4 cup cream 5 sprigs coriander leaves, finely chopped Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Green Moong Dal Makhani, first soak the moong dal in 3 cups of water for 2 hours. Put this dal in a pressure cooker along with water and salt. Cook till 3 whistles. Turn off the gas and let the pressure release automatically. Now heat oil in a pan. Add ginger and let it cook for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds add tomatoes, green chilies, turmeric powder, black pepper powder, cumin powder and let it cook for 1 minute. After 1 minute add dal and some water. Cover the pan and let it cook for 15 minutes. After 10 minutes add cream and coriander leaves. Mix it and let it cook for another 5 minutes. Serve Green Moong Dal Makhani with Bhindi Masala and Phulkas for lunch.

name: Kaddu Simla Mirch Sabzi Recipe - Pumpkin Capsicum Sabzi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Pumpkin Capsicum Sabzi is a simple recipe which you can make for everyday meal and you can also pack it in your lunch box. This is a very simple recipe and only everyday spices are used in it.
ingredients_name: Pumpkin,Tomato,Green Bell Pepper,Green Chilli,Mustard Seeds,Cumin,Fenugreek Seeds,Turmeric Powder,Sambar Powder,Jaggery,Oil,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 kg pumpkin 2 tomatoes , chopped 1 capsicum (green) , chopped 1 green chilli , finely chopped 1/2 teaspoon mustard seeds 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1 teaspoon sambar powder 1 tablespoon jaggery 1 teaspoon oil Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Pumpkin Capsicum Sabzi, first heat oil in a wok. Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds and fenugreek seeds. Let it cook for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds add green chillies, capsicum and let it cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Now add turmeric powder, red chilli powder, tomatoes, pumpkin, sambar powder, salt and jaggery. Mix and let it cook for 2 minutes. Let the pumpkin cook. After cooking, turn off the gas and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve Pumpkin Capsicum Sabzi with Phalguni Daal and Tawa Paratha.

name: Palak Baingan Ki Sabzi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Palak Baingan Sabzi is a very simple dish that you can make for everyday meals. You can also pack this dish in your lunch box.
ingredients_name: Eggplant,Spinach,Ginger,Garlic,Cumin,Curry Leaves,Coriander Powder,Red Chili Powder,Asafoetida,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 10 brinjals, small, cut into wedges 300 grams spinach, chopped 1 inch ginger, grated 3 cloves garlic, finely chopped 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 1 sprig curry leaves, finely chopped 1 teaspoon coriander powder 1/2 teaspoon red chilli powder 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Palak Baingan ki Sabzi, first heat oil in a pan. Add spinach, some salt and cook till the spinach becomes soft. After it is cooked, turn off the gas and keep it aside. Now add some more oil in the same pan. Add cumin seeds and curry leaves to it. Let it cook for 15 seconds. After that add ginger, garlic, brinjal, salt. Mix it, cover the pan and cook till the brinjal becomes soft. Keep stirring it at times. After the brinjal becomes soft, add asafoetida, coriander powder, red chilli powder and let it cook for 2 minutes. Now add cooked spinach and mix it. Let it cook for 30 seconds and serve. Serve Palak Baingan ki Sabzi with Gujarati Kadhi and Methi Thepla for lunch.

name: Potato and Radish Leaves Vegetable Recipe - Aloo Aur Mooli Ke Patto Ki Sabzi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Potato and Radish Leaves Sabzi is a simple, healthy recipe where vegetables are cooked with potatoes. Mustard oil is used to add flavour to the curry. Dried red chillies and garlic are also added to enhance the taste of this curry.
ingredients_name: Radish Leaves,Potato,Garlic,Dried Red Chilli,Mustard Oil,Salt,Cumin Powder,Red Chili Powder,Turmeric Powder
ingredients_quantity: 300 gms radish leaves 2 potatoes, boiled, peeled and chopped 4 cloves garlic, finely chopped 2 dried red chillies, broken in the middle 2 tbsp mustard oil Salt, to taste 1 tsp cumin powder 1 tsp red chilli powder 1 tsp turmeric powder
instructions: To make Potato and Radish Leaves Sabzi, first wash and chop the radish leaves. Now heat oil in a pan. Add radish leaves, salt and cook till the leaves become soft. Keep it aside. Now heat oil in the same pan. Add cumin seeds, dry red chillies and cook for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds add garlic and let it cook for 30 seconds. After that add potatoes. After 1 minute add salt, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder. Mix it and cook till the potatoes are cooked. Now add radish leaves and mix it. Let it cook for 30 seconds and serve hot. Serve Potato and Radish Leaves Sabzi with Rajasthani Daal and Phulkas for lunch.

name: Lemon Buttermilk Cake Recipe
description: Lemon Buttermilk Cake Recipe is a lemony and zesty buttermilk and corn flour cake which makes a wonderful breakfast or a snack for anytime of the day. This lemon buttermilk cake is damn delicious and totally irresistible. You can make these for high tea and continental theme parties as well. Serve Lemon Buttermilk Cake Recipe along with Hot Coffee Latte Recipe and Lemon And Rosemary Shortbread Cookies Recipe.
ingredients_name: Vivatta Maida,Corn flour,Butter (Unsalted),Baking powder,Baking soda,Buttermilk,Caster Sugar,Lemon zest,Lemons,Caster Sugar,Icing Sugar,Lemon juice
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Vivatta Maida  1 cup Corn flour  1 cup Butter (Unsalted)  1/4 teaspoon Baking powder  1/4 teaspoon Baking soda  2 cups Buttermilk  1/4 cup Caster Sugar  3 tablespoons Lemon zest For syrup 2 Lemons , juiced  1/2 cup Caster Sugar For Icing 1-1/2 cups Icing Sugar  2 tablespoons Lemon juice
instructions: To begin making Lemon Buttermilk Cake Recipe, preheat oven to 180C and grease a loaf tin with butter and dust with flour.Sift the corn and plain flour into a mixing bowl along with baking powder and baking soda.In another mixing bowl beat sugar with butter until light and fluffy. Stir in lemon zest and set aside.Add a half teaspoon of lemon juice into buttermilk and mix well.Now add the flour mixture into the sugar butter mixture alternating with buttermilk and mix well until combined.Transfer the batter into the prepared pan and bake in preheated oven for about  40 to 50 minutes or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.Cool the cake on a wire rack with a baking tray underneath it.To make the syrup put all ingredients in a saucepan and cook until sugar is dissolved.Pierce the cake with a skewer and pour the syrup all over the cake while it is still warm.To make the icing add the lemon juice gradually into the icing sugar until desired consistency. Pour the icing over the cake and let the extra drizzle down into the tray. Sprinkle some lemon zest if desired, slice and serve the cake.Serve Lemon Buttermilk Cake Recipe along with Hot Coffee Latte Recipe and Lemon And Rosemary Shortbread Cookies Recipe.

name: Upside Down Pear Ginger Cake Recipe
description: Upside down pear and ginger cake recipe made with whole wheat flour is a warm and delicious tarte tatin like dessert but has a cake base. The pears are coated in caramel and ginger syrup and bring wonderful flavours in the cake. This recipe is easier to prepare than it appears to be in the finished food picture. Go try this out for your upcoming birthday party and enjoy this Upside Down Pear Ginger Cake Recipe with Zucchini Parmesan Crisps (Chips) Recipe, Bombay Masala Sandwich Recipe With Rocket Leaves.
ingredients_name: Whole Wheat Flour,Almond Meal (Badam Powder),Extra Virgin Olive Oil,Curd (Dahi / Yogurt),Caster Sugar,Honey,Ginger,Baking powder,Pears,Lemon juice,Butter (Unsalted),Honey,Caster Sugar,Ginger
ingredients_quantity: For Cake 1 cup Whole Wheat Flour  1/4 cup Almond Meal (Badam Powder)  1/2 cup Extra Virgin Olive Oil  1/2 cup Curd (Dahi / Yogurt)  1/2 cup Caster Sugar  2 tablespoons Honey  2 teaspoons Ginger , grated  1 teaspoon Baking powder For pears topping 3 Pears , sliced  1 tablespoon Lemon juice  4 tablespoons Butter (Unsalted)  4 tablespoons Honey  4 tablespoons Caster Sugar  1 teaspoon Ginger , grated
instructions: To begin making Upside Down Pear Ginger Cake Recipe, in a saucepan add butter, honey, sugar and grated ginger. Let the syrup melt and cook until it becomes golden.While the syrup is cooking, prepare the cake tin or cast iron pan by lightly greasing it with butter and flouring it. Tap off the excess flour after its coated without disturbing the inner lining of the cake pan.Remove from heat and pour this syrup into the prepared cake tin or ovenproof frying pan.Arrange pear slices in the cake tin or frying pan which you are using. Set aside.Preheat oven to 350 degree F and grease. In a mixing bowl sift together whole wheat flour, baking powder.Add in ground almonds and set aside. In another mixing bowl beat together olive oil and sugar.Stir in yogurt, honey and ginger. Whisk to combine. Add the dry ingredients into the wet in two batches.Gently fold in all the ingredients to make a batter. Pour the cake batter on top of the pears and cover them completely.Tap on the kitchen counter to free the air gaps if any. Bake in preheated oven for about 35 to 40 minutes or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.Remove the cake from oven and allow it to cool. Loosen the sides with a knife and flip the cake onto serving plate.Slice and serve with ice cream. Serve Upside Down Pear Ginger Cake Recipe topped with ice cream along with Zucchini Parmesan Crisps (Chips) Recipe, Bombay Masala Sandwich Recipe With Rocket Leaves.

name: Iranian Baida Curry Recipe
description: Iranian Baida Curry Recipe is a creamy and comfort egg curry recipe. The gravy is simply made from roasted almonds, poppy seeds, sesame seeds, freshly grated coconut that is ground to make creamy paste. The gravy is then cooked with basic spice powders and finished off with boiled egg. The boiled egg are cut and added to the gravy so that it will soak in most of the flavors from the curry and is delicious to eat it along with soft pav or steamed rice.
ingredients_name: Whole Egg,Onion,Jaggery,Salt,Oil,Coriander (Dhania) Leaves,Fresh coconut,Coriander (Dhania) Seeds,Dry Red Chilli,Sesame seeds (Til seeds),Poppy seeds,Ginger,Garlic,Whole Almonds (Badam)
ingredients_quantity: 4 Whole Egg  1 Onion , chopped  1 tablespoon Jaggery Salt , to taste Oil  1 sprig Coriander (Dhania) Leaves Ingredients to grind 1/4 cup Fresh coconut , grated  2 tablespoon Coriander (Dhania) Seeds  3 Dry Red Chilli  1 tablespoon Sesame seeds (Til seeds)  1 tablespoon Poppy seeds  1 inch Ginger , chopped  5 cloves Garlic , chopped  8 Whole Almonds (Badam)
instructions: To begin making the Iranian Baida Curry Recipe, boil the whole egg in water, make sure the eggs are fully immersed.Boil them for at least 15 minutes until the eggs are completely cooked and keep them aside to de shell them once it cools down.Dry roast the ingredients mentioned in the list to grind on to a pan, once done cool it down and grind it into a smooth paste by adding little water.Heat a kadai with oil, add onions and saute them until it turns golden brown. Add the ground masala paste. Saute for 10 minutes.Add 1 cup of water along with jaggery and bring it to a boil. Check for salt and adjust according to your palate.Finally, de-shell the eggs, cut them into half and drop them into the boiling curry. Boil the curry for 2 more minutes and switch it off. Serve by garnishing it with some coriander leaves.Serve the Iranian Baida Curry Recipe along with Garlic naan, Chapathi and some steamed rice along with Moong Sprouts Salad with Grated Carrots and Coriander.

name: Aloo Parwal Sabzi Recipe - Aloo Parwal Sabzi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Aloo Parwal ki Sabzi is a Bengali dish which is made in every household of Bengal. It is very healthy and you can make it for everyday meals. You can also pack this sabzi in your lunch box.
ingredients_name: Pointed Gourd,Potato,Peanuts,Turmeric Powder,Red Chili Powder,Coriander Powder,Coriander Leaves,Mustard Seeds,Salt,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 15 pointed gourd, cut into wedges 3 potatoes, cut into wedges 1/4 cup peanuts, roasted and lightly ground 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1 teaspoon red chilli powder 1 teaspoon coriander powder 4 sprigs coriander leaves, chopped (for garnish) 1 teaspoon mustard seeds Salt, to taste Oil, as needed
instructions: To make Aloo Parwal ki Sabzi, first heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and let it cook for 10 seconds. Now add parwal and salt and cook till parwal is half cooked. Now add potatoes and cook till both the vegetables are cooked. After cooking, add turmeric powder, red chili powder and coriander powder. Add salt according to taste and let it cook for 2 to 3 minutes. After that, turn off the gas and serve hot. Serve Aloo Parwal Ki Sabzi with Garlic Daal and Phulkas for lunch.

name: गोभी के पत्तो की चटनी रेसिपी - Cauliflower Leaves Chutney (Recipe In Hindi)
description: गोभी के पत्तो की चटनी एक सरल और स्वादिष्ट रेसिपी है जिसमे फूल गोभी के पत्तो का प्रयोग किया जाता है. आप इन पतियों को सलाद, ग्रेवी आदि में भी प्रयोग कर सकते है.
ingredients_name: Cauliflower Leaves,Tomato,Tamarind,White Urad Dal,Dried Red Chilli,Salt,Asafoetida,Garlic,Turmeric Powder,Oil,Mustard Seeds,Cumin,Curry Leaves
ingredients_quantity: 1 कप गोभी के पत्ते  3/4 कप टमाटर  18 ग्राम इमली  2 बड़े चमच्च सफ़ेद उरद दाल  4 सुखी लाल मिर्च नमक , स्वाद अनुसार हींग , चुटकी भर  3 कली लहसुन हल्दी पाउडर , चुटकी भर  1 बड़ा चमच्च तेल  1 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1/2 छोटा चमच्च जीरा  1 टहनी कढ़ी पत्ता
instructions: गोभी के पत्तो की चटनी को बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले गोभी के अंदर की पत्तिया निकाले और अच्छी तरह से धो ले. सूखा ले और अच्छी तरह से काट ले.एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम कर ले. इसमें उरद दाल, सुखी लाल मिर्च डाले और दाल के सुनहरा होने तक पकाए। अलग से रख दे. उसी कढ़ाई में थोड़ा और तेल डाले। इसमें गोभी के पत्ते, नमक डाले और पत्तो के नरम होने तक पकाए। अब इसमें टमाटर, लहसुन डाले और अच्छी तरह से मिला ले. टमाटर के नरम होने तक पकाए। पकने के बाद, गैस बंद करें और इस मिश्रण को ठंडा होने दे. इसे एक मिक्सर ग्राइंडर में दाल के मिश्रण के साथ डाले और पीस ले. थोड़ा पानी और नमक डाले और एक बार फिर से पीस ले.  तड़के के लिए, एक तड़का पैन में राइ डाले। 10 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसमें जीरा, हींग और कढ़ी पत्ता डाले। 15 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसे चटनी में डाले और मिला ले. गोभी के पत्तो की चटनी को वेजिटेबल सांबर और चावल के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: Paka Kela Ki Sabzi Recipe - Ripe Banana Vegetable Recipe (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Paka Kela Sabzi is a Gujarati dish made from bananas. In this sabzi, bananas are cooked with turmeric powder, asafoetida, curry leaves and chillies. Easy to make and delicious to eat, you can make this sabzi for your everyday meal.
ingredients_name: Banana,Besan,Asafoetida,Turmeric Powder,Red Chili Powder,Cumin,Mustard Seeds,Curry Leaves,Oil,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 3 cups banana, chopped 2 tbsp gram flour 1/4 tsp asafoetida 1/2 tsp turmeric powder 1/2 tsp red chilli powder 1/4 tsp cumin seeds 1/4 tsp mustard seeds 5 curry leaves, finely chopped 2 tsp oil Salt, according to taste
instructions: To make Ripe Banana Sabzi, first take banana, asafoetida, turmeric powder, red chilli powder, salt, gram flour in a large bowl, mix it and keep it aside. Now heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves and let it cook for 10 seconds. Now add banana mixture and let it cook for 3 to 4 minutes. After cooking, turn off the gas and serve it hot. Serve Ripe Banana Sabzi with Gujarati Daal and Methi Thepla for lunch.

name: Red Chilli and Tomato Pachadi Recipe – Red Chilli and Tomato Pachadi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Red chilli and tomato pachadi is a simple and quick recipe that requires very few ingredients. It has a tangy taste and is spiced with red chillies. Full of flavour, you can serve this chutney with your meal.
ingredients_name: Oil,White Urad Dal,Chana Dal,Red Chili,Tomato,Salt,Tamarind Paste,Mustard Seeds,Cumin,Curry Leaves
ingredients_quantity: 2 tbsp oil 1/2 tbsp white urad dal 1/2 tbsp chana dal 8 red chillies , fresh, chopped 4 tomatoes , chopped Salt, to taste 1/2 tbsp tamarind paste 1/2 tbsp mustard seeds 1/2 tbsp cumin seeds 10 curry leaves
instructions: To make Red Chilli and Tomato Pachadi, first heat oil in a pan. Now add urad dal, chana dal and cook for 1 minute. After 1 minute, add tomatoes and red chillies. Add salt and cook till tomatoes become soft. Turn off the gas and let it cool. Now put it in a mixer grinder and grind it. For tempering, heat oil in a tempering pan. Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds and curry leaves. Let it cook for 20 seconds. Pour this tempering into the pachadi and mix it. Serve Red Chilli and Tomato Pachadi with Dosa, Rava Dosa or any paratha of your choice.

name: धनिये और नारियल की चटनी रेसिपी - Green Coriander And Coconut Chutney (Recipe (In Hindi)
description: धनिये और नारियल की चटनी एक सरल और ताज़ा रेसिपी है जो आप अपने खाने के साथ परोस सकते है. धनिये और अदरक के डालने से इस चटनी को स्वाद और भी बढ़ जाता है. आप इस चटनी को समोसा या कचोरी के साथ भी परोस सकते है.
ingredients_name: Coconut,Coriander Leaves,Green Chilli,Ginger,Cumin,Salt,Lemon Juice
ingredients_quantity: 150 ग्राम नारियल , कस ले  100 ग्राम हरा धनिया , ताज़ा  1 हरी मिर्च , काट ले  1 इंच अदरक , काट ले  1/2 छोटा चमच्च जीरा नमक , स्वाद अनुसार  1 बड़ा चमच्च निम्बू का रस

instructions: नारियल मूंगफली की चटनी बनाने के लिए सारी सामग्री तैयार कर ले.एक एक कर के सारी सामग्री मिक्सर ग्राइंडर में डाले और पीस ले. एक बाउल में निकाले और परोसे। नारियल मूंगफली की चटनी को रवा इडली, गाजर इडली या अपने पसंद के डोसे के साथ परोसे।

name: साउथ इंडियन प्याज चटनी रेसिपी - South Indian Onion Chutney (Recipe In Hindi)
description: साउथ इंडियन प्याज की चटनी आप इडली या डोसे के साथ परोस सकते है. खाने में स्वादिष्ट और बनाने में आसान आप इस चटनी को अपने लंच बॉक्स में भी पैक कर सकते है. इस चटनी को उल्ली पचड़ी भी कहा जाता है.
ingredients_name: Onion,Cumin,Split Black Urad Dal,Tamarind Paste,Dried Red Chilli,Jaggery,Oil,Salt,Mustard Seeds,Curry Leaves,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 2 प्याज  1 छोटा चमच्च जीरा  2 बड़े चमच्च काली उरद दाल (स्प्लिट)  1 बड़ा चमच्च इमली का पेस्ट  3 सुखी लाल मिर्च  1/2 छोटा चमच्च गुड़  2 छोटे चमच्च तेल नमक , स्वाद अनुसार तड़के के लिए 1 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1 टहनी कढ़ी पत्ता  1/2 छोटा चमच्च तेल
instructions: साउथ इंडियन प्याज चटनी बनाने के लिए सब पहले प्याज को काट ले और अलग से रख दे. अब 1 छोटा चमच्च तेल कढ़ाई में गरम करें। इसमें जीरा, सुखी लाल मिर्च डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स के लिए पकने दे.अब इसमें उरद दाल डाले और सुनहरा होने तक पकने दे. गैस बंद करें और एक बाउल में निकाल दे. उसी कड़ाही में एक चमच्च तेल और डाले। इसमें प्याज डाले और 4 से 5 मिनट तक पकने दे. गैस बंद करें और ठंडा होने दे.अब उरद दाल, जीरा और सुखी लाल मिर्च को मिक्सर ग्राइंडर में डाले और पीस ले. इसमें पके हुए प्याज, इमली और गुड़ डाले। थोड़ा पानी डाले और पीस ले. अब तड़के के लिए, एक छोटी कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें राइ और कढ़ी पत्ता डाले। 10 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसे चटनी में डाले और मिला ले. साउथ इंडियन प्याज की चटनी को मसाला डोसा या घी डोसा के साथ सुनाग के नाश्ते के लिए परोसे।

name: Cabbage Pachadi Recipe – Cabbage Pachadi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Cabbage Pachadi is a kind of chutney which you can serve with idli, dosa or paratha in your breakfast. It is not only tasty but also healthy and easy to make.
ingredients_name: Sesame Oil,White Urad Dal,Roasted Chana Dal,Cabbage,Green Chilli,Curry Leaves,Salt,Tamarind Paste,Water,Mustard Seeds,Asafoetida,Dried Red Chilli,Oil
ingredients_quantity: 2 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp white urad dal 1 tbsp roasted chana dal 2 cups cabbage, chopped 3 green chillies, chopped 10 curry leaves Salt, to taste 1/2 tbsp tamarind paste 1/2 cup water 1/2 tbsp mustard seeds Asafoetida, a pinch 2 dried red chillies 2 tsp oil
instructions: To make Cabbage Pachadi, first heat oil in a pan. Add urad dal and chana dal in it. Cook till it becomes light brown. Now add green chillies and curry leaves. After 15 seconds add cabbage and salt. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes and then turn off the gas. After the cabbage mixture cools down, put it in a mixer grinder along with tamarind and some water. Grind it and take it out in a bowl. Now for the tempering, heat oil in a tempering pan. Add mustard seeds and cook for 10 seconds. Add asafoetida and mix it. Pour this tempering into the chutney and mix it. Serve Cabbage Pachadi with Onion Uttapam, Ghee Dosa or Masala Dosa.

name: लहसुन टमाटर की चटनी रेसिपी - Roasted Garlic Tomato Chutney (Recipe In Hindi)
description: लहसुन टमाटर की चटनी जो एक बहुत ही स्वादिष्ट चटनी है जिसमे लहुसन का ज्यादा प्रयोग किया जाता है. इसमें टमाटर का भी प्रयोग किया जाता है जो इस चटनी को खट्टापन देता है. आप इस चटनी को अपने नाश्ते में या खाने के साथ परोस सकते है.
ingredients_name: Garlic,Tomato,Dried Red Chilli,Tamarind,Oil,Salt,Oil,Mustard Seeds,Curry Leaves,Asafoetida,Dried Red Chilli
ingredients_quantity: 1 कप लहसुन  1 टमाटर  5 सुखी लाल मिर्च  18 ग्राम इमली , (small lemon sized)  1 छोटा चमच्च तेल नमक , to taste Ingredients to prepare tadka 1 छोटा चमच्च तेल  1/2 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1 टहनी कढ़ी पत्ता हींग , चुटकी भर  1 सुखी लाल मिर्च
instructions: लहसुन टमाटर की चटनी बनाने के लिए सब पहले लहुसन को छील ले और अलग से रख दे. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें सुखी लाल मिर्च और लहसुन डाले और लहुसन के सुनहरा होने तक पकाए और अलग से रख दे. उसी कढ़ाई में टमाटर और इमली डाले और टमाटर के नरम होने तक पकाए। अलग से रख दे अब लहसुन, सुखी लाल मिर्च और टमाटर के मिश्रण को मिक्सर ग्राइंडर में नमक के साथ डाले और पीस ले. एक बाउल में निकाल लेतड़के के लिए, एक छोटी कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें राइ डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसमें सुखी लाल मिर्च, कढ़ी पत्ता, हींग डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स तक पकने दे. यह तड़का चटनी में डाले और मिला ले. लहसुन टमाटर की सब्ज़ी को आलू की सब्ज़ी और पूरी के साथ रात के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: Soya Chunks Masala Recipe - Soya Chunks Masala in Coconut Milk (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Soya chunks masala is a spicy dish in which soya chunks are cooked in coconut milk. It also uses many common spices which enhance its taste. Try this recipe once and we are sure that you will definitely like it.
ingredients_name: Soy Chunks,Tomato,Onion,Green Chilli,Garlic,Cumin,Curry Leaves,Turmeric Powder,Red Chili Powder,Coriander Powder,Curry Powder,Coconut Milk,Oil,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 2 cups soya chunks, boiled and drained 2 tomatoes, thinly sliced ​​1 onion, finely chopped 3 green chillies, thinly sliced ​​3 cloves garlic, grated 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 1 sprig curry leaves 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder 1 teaspoon red chilli powder 1 teaspoon coriander powder 1 teaspoon curry powder 1/2 cup coconut milk Oil, as needed Salt, to taste
instructions: To make Soya Chunks Masala, prepare all the ingredients first. Heat water in a saucepan and let it boil. Add soya chunks and cook till soya becomes soft. Once cooked, take out soya and squeeze it to remove water. Keep it aside. Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds, curry leaves and green chilies. After 30 seconds, add onion, ginger, garlic and cook till onion becomes soft. When onion becomes soft, add tomatoes and cook till tomatoes become soft. When tomatoes become soft, add coriander powder, red chili powder and turmeric powder. Mix and cook for 1 minute. Add soya chunks and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Add coconut milk, water, salt and curry powder. Mix and cook for at least 5 minutes. Add salt as per taste and cook for 1 more minute. Turn off the gas and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve Soya Chunks Masala along with Spinach Raita and Laccha Paratha for dinner.

name: गोभी कुरमा रेसिपी - Cauliflower Kurma (Recipe In Hindi)
description: अगर आप तमिल नाडु के किसी अच्छे होटल में जाते है तो
ingredients_name: Cauliflower,Tomato,Small Onions,Green Chilli,Garlic,Ginger,Turmeric Powder,Cumin Powder,Salt,Coconut,Fennel Seeds,Cashew,Poppy Seeds,Coriander Seeds,Roasted Chana Dal,Dried Red Chilli,Coconut Oil,Cloves,Cardamom,Star Anise,Bay Leaf,Curry Leaves
ingredients_quantity: 1 गोभी , काट ले  1 टमाटर , बारीक काट ले  15 छोटे प्याज , बारीक काट ले  3 हरी मिर्च , सीधा और पतला काट ले  4 कली लहसुन , कस ले  1 इंच अदरक , कस ले  1/4 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर  1/4 छोटा चमच्च जीरा पाउडर नमक , स्वाद अनुसार मसाला पेस्ट के लिए 4 छोटे चमच्च नारियल , बारीक काट ले  1 छोटा चमच्च सौंफ  1 छोटा चमच्च काजू  1 छोटा चमच्च खस खस  1/2 छोटा चमच्च धनिये के बीज  1 छोटा चमच्च रोस्टेड चना दाल  2 सुखी लाल मिर्च तड़के के लिए 1 बड़ा चमच्च नारियल का तेल   1 लॉन्ग  1 इलाइची  1 स्टार अनीस  1 तेज पत्ता  1 टहनी कढ़ी पत्ता
instructions: गोभी कुरमा बनाने के लिए सब पहले मसाला बनाए के लिए दी गई सामग्री को 1/4 कप गरम पानी में 20 मिनुएट के लिए भिगो दे. अब इसे एक मिक्सर ग्राइंडर में डाले और थोड़े पानी डालकर पेस्ट बना ले. अब एक सॉसपैन में 3 कप पानी डालदे दे. इसमें गोभी डाले और 5 मिनट तक पकने दे. पानी निकाल ले और गोभी को अलग से रख दे.  अब एक कढ़ाई में नारियल का तेल गरम करें। इसमें तड़के के लिए दी गई सामग्री डाले। अब इसमें कसा हुआ अदरक, लहसुन, छोटे प्याज, टमाटर और नमक डाले। प्याज और तातार के पकने तक पकाए। अब इसमें हल्दी पाउडर, जीरा पाउडर और 1/2 कप पानी डाले। मिला ले और 3 से 4 मिनट तक पकने दे. अब इसमें गोभी डाले और 5 मिनट और पकने दे. 5 मिनट के बाद पिसा हुआ मसाला और स्वाद अनुसार नमक डाले। मिला ले और अगले 5 मिनट तक पकने दे. गैस बंद करें और गरमा गरम परोसे। गोभी कुर्मा को चाउ चाउ थोरन और चावल के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे। आप इसे अप्पम के साथ भी परोस सकते है

name: Kadhai Tofu Sabji Recipe (Recipe In Hindi)
description: In Kadhai Tofu ki Sabzi, tofu and other vegetables are cooked with everyday spices. This is a simple recipe that you can make for your everyday meal.
ingredients_name: Tofu,Green Bell Pepper,Onion,Garlic,Ginger,Tomato,Cumin,Kasuri Methi,Oil,Turmeric Powder,Sugar,Salt,Coriander Leaves,Coriander Seeds,Whole Black Pepper,Fennel Seeds,Cumin,Pomegranate Seeds,Dried Red Chilli,Bay Leaf,Black Cardamom,Dried Mango Powder
ingredients_quantity: 250 gms tofu, diced 1 capsicum (green) , chopped 1 onion, chopped 1 tsp garlic paste 1 tsp ginger paste 2 tomatoes, boiled, peeled and finely chopped 1 tsp cumin seeds 1 tsp kasuri methi, crushed 1 tbsp oil 1/2 tsp turmeric powder 1/2 tsp sugar Salt, to taste Coriander leaves, for grinding 2 tsp coriander seeds 5 whole black pepper 1 tsp fennel seeds 1 tsp cumin seeds 1 tsp pomegranate seeds 4 dried red chillies 1 bay leaf 1 big cardamom 1/2 teaspoon dry mango powder
instructions: To make Kadai Tofu, first we will make the masala. In a small pan, add coriander seeds, black pepper, cumin seeds, dried red chillies, bay leaves and big cardamom. Fry it for 30 seconds and keep it aside to cool. Now put this mixture in the mixer grinder along with pomegranate seeds and dry mango powder. Grind it and keep it aside. Now heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and onion in it. Cook till the onion becomes soft and then add garlic and ginger paste. After 1 minute add turmeric powder, tomato puree and let it cook for 2 minutes. Now add 2 tablespoons of ground masala and kasuri methi in it. Add capsicum and let it cook for 1 minute. Now add tofu, salt and sugar. Mix it and let it cook for next 2 minutes. Now garnish with green coriander and serve hot. Serve Kadhai Tofu along with Dal Makhani and Tawa Paratha for dinner.

name: Potato Vindaloo Recipe - Potato Vindaloo (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Aloo Vindaloo is a spicy Goan curry which tastes different from other potato curries. In Goa, prawn or chicken Vindaloo is made,  this is a veg recipe of the same.
ingredients_name: Dried Kashmiri Chilli,Fenugreek Seeds,Garlic,Small Onions,Cumin,Turmeric Powder,Vinegar,Water,Potato,Salt,Oil,Mustard Seeds,Curry Leaves,Water,Sugar
ingredients_quantity: For Vindaloo paste 12 dried Kashmiri chillies, broken and soaked in hot water for 1/2 hour 1/4 tsp fenugreek seeds, roasted 7 cloves garlic 4 small onions, peeled 1/2 tsp cumin seeds 1/4 tsp turmeric powder 2 tsp vinegar 1/3 cup water, as needed Potatoes For Vindaloo 3 potatoes, peeled and diced Salt, to taste 2 tbsp oil 1 tsp mustard seeds 10 curry leaves Water, as needed 1/2 tsp sugar
instructions: To make Aloo Vindaloo, first heat a saucepan. Add chopped potatoes, water and salt in it. Cook till the potatoes are half cooked or become soft. Drain the water from the potatoes and keep both separately. Now put the ingredients given for Vindaloo masala in a mixer grinder and grind it. Now heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and curry leaves in it and let it cook for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds, add Vindaloo paste and let it cook for 3 minutes. After 3 minutes, add 1/2 cup water, potatoes, salt and mix it. Cook for 10 to 12 minutes. After that add some sugar, mix it and serve hot. Serve Aloo Vindaloo with Sol Kadhi and Rice for lunch.

name: गोअन स्टाइल मशरुम रेसिपी - Goan Style Mushrooms (Recipe In Hindi)
description: गोअन स्टाइल मशरुम एक तीखी सब्ज़ी है जिसमे मशरुम को रोज के मसालो के साथ पकाया जाता है. आप इसे अपनी पार्टीज के लिए स्नैक के रूप में भी परोस सकते है।
ingredients_name: Button Mushroom,Oil,Semolina,Rice Flour,Garlic,Turmeric Powder,Red Chili Powder,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 250 ग्राम बटन मशरुम तेल , तलने के लिए ऊपर परत के लिए 1 कप सूजी  1/4 कप चावल का आटा  3 कली लहसुन , कस ले  1 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर  1 छोटा चमच्च लाल मिर्च पाउडर नमक , स्वाद अनुसार
instructions: गोअन स्टाइल मशरुम बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले मुषर्रम को धो कर सूखा ले. मशरुम को स्टेम के साथ आधा काट ले. एक बाउल ले और उसमे परत के लिए दी गई सामग्री डाले।  मशरुम डाले और अच्छी तरह से मिला ले. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गर्म करें। इसमें मशरुम डाले और क्रिस्प होने तक पका ले. इस में 15 मिनट लगते है. बन जाने के बाद गरमा गरम परोसे। गोअन स्टाइल मशरुम को पालक रायता एंड तवा पराठा के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: खट्टा मीठा पेठा रेसिपी - Khatta Meetha Petha (Recipe In Hindi)
description: खट्टा मीठा पेठा एक सरल, स्वादिष्ट और जल्दी बन जाने वाली सब्ज़ी है. इसमें सौंफ और काली मिर्च डाली जाती है जो इसके स्वाद को और भी बढ़ाता है.
ingredients_name: Pumpkin,Green Chilli,Whole Black Pepper,Oil,Fennel Seeds,Sugar,Salt,Dried Mango Powder,Coriander Leaves
ingredients_quantity: 1 कद्दू  4 हरी मिर्च  1/2 छोटा चमच्च पूरी काली मिर्च  1 बड़ा चमच्च तेल  1 छोटा चमच्च सौंफ  1 छोटा चमच्च शक्कर नमक  1 अमचूर हरा धनिया , बारीक काट ले
instructions: खट्टा मीठा पेठा बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले कद्दू को छीलकर काट ले. हरी मिर्च भी काट कर अलग से रख दे.  एक कढ़ाई में सौंफ और काली मिर्च डाले। 15 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसे बाउल में निकाले और अलग से रख दे. उसी कढ़ाई में थोड़ा और तेल डाले। कद्दू, नमक डाले और कद्दू के नरम होने तक पकाए। नरम होने के बाद इसमें शक्कर, हरी मिर्च डाले और मिला ले. कढ़ाई को ढके और 2 मिनट तक पकने दे. अब सौंफ, काली मिर्च को क्रश कर ले. कढ़ाई को खोले और यह मिश्रण सब्ज़ी में डाल दे. अमचूर पाउडर, नमक डाले, मिलाए और 1 मिनट तक पकने दे. गैस बंद करें और हरे धनिये से गार्निश करें। खट्टा मीठा पेठा को लहसुनि दाल, बूंदी रायता और फुल्के के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।.

name: Pudina Moong Dal Recipe (Recipe In Hindi)
description: Mint is considered good for our body as it detoxifies our body. This is a simple recipe in which mint has been used. It is prepared in less time so it can be prepared for everyday meals.
ingredients_name: Yellow Moong Dal,Red Chili Powder,Turmeric Powder,Cumin,Asafoetida,Ghee,Mint,Water,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1/2 cup yellow moong dal 1/2 tsp red chilli powder 1/4 tsp turmeric powder 1/4 tsp cumin seeds asafoetida 1 tbsp ghee 2 tbsp mint, chopped Water, as per requirement Salt, as per taste
instructions: To make Pudina Moong Dal, first put moong dal, 1 cup water and turmeric in a pressure cooker and cook till 2 whistles. After the pressure is released, open the cooker and add 1-1/2 cups water and salt to it. Turn on the gas and let it boil for 3 to 4 minutes. Now we will make its Tadka (tempering). Heat ghee or oil in a small pan. Add cumin seeds and asafoetida to it. After 10 seconds add mint leaves and red chili powder to it. Pour this tempering in the dal, mix it and let it cook for another 2 to 3 minutes. Turn off the gas and serve hot. Serve Pudina Moong Dal with Besan Arbi Roast and Phulkas for lunch.

name: गाजर मूंगफली की चटनी रेसिपी - Carrot Peanut Chutney (Recipe In Hindi)
description: गाजर मूंगफली की चटनी को आप डोसा या इडली के साथ नाश्ते में परोस सकते है. इसमें नारियल का प्रयोग किया गया है, अगर आप चाहे तो नारियल के बिना भी बना सकते है. यह चटनी खाने में तो स्वादिष्ट है ही, साथ में सेहतमंद भी है.
ingredients_name: Carrot,Peanuts,Mint,Coconut,Onion,Garlic,Green Chilli,Salt,Sesame Oil,Mustard Seeds,Curry Leaves
ingredients_quantity: 1 गाजर , छीलकर काट ले  2 बड़े चमच्च मूंगफली  , सेक ले  1/4 कप पुदीना  1 बड़ा चमच्च नारियल , कस ले  1 प्याज  1 बड़ा चमच्च लहसुन , काट ले  3 हरी मिर्च नमक , स्वाद अनुसार  1 छोटा चमच्च तिल का तेल  1 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1 टहनी कढ़ी पत्ता
instructions: गाजर मूंगफली की चटनी बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले मूंगफली को एक कढ़ाई में डाले और सुनहरा होने तक सेक ले. गैस बंद करें और मूंगफली को ठंडा होने दे. ठंडा होने के बाद उसका छिलका निकाल ले.अब एक कढ़ाई में थोड़ा तेल गरम करें। इसमें राइ, कढ़ी पत्ता डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स के लिए पकने दे. अब इसमें प्याज, हरी मिर्च और लहसुन डाले और प्याज के नरम होने तक पकाए। अब नारियल, गाजर और पुदीने के पत्ते डाले। 5 मिनट तक पकाए और गैस बंद कर दे. ठंडा होने दे.इस मिश्रण को एक मिक्सर ग्राइंडर में थोड़े पानी के साथ डाले और पीस ले. नमक डाले, मिलाए और परोसे। गाजर मूंगफली की चटनी को घी डोसा या रवा इडली के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: प्रॉन फ्राइड राइस रेसिपी - Prawns Fried Rice (Recipe In Hindi)
description: प्रॉन फ्राइड राइस में चावल को मेरिनेट किये हुए प्रॉन्स, सब्जिआ और सॉस के साथ बनाया जाता है. यह बनाने में आसान है और बहुत काम समय में तैयार हो जाता है. आप इसे दिन या रात के खाने के लिए बना सकते है.
ingredients_name: Rice,Bay Leaf,Onion,Garlic,Ginger,Soy Sauce,Carrot,Green Chilli Sauce,Green Bell Pepper,Roasted Tomato Sauce,Prawn,Butter,Oil,Cloves,Whole Black Pepper,Cinnamon Powder,Black Pepper Powder,Coriander Leaves,Salt,Red Chili Powder,Turmeric Powder,Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 कप चावल  2 तेज पत्ता  2 प्याज  5 कली लहसुन  1/2 इंच अदरक  1 छोटा चमच्च सोया सॉस  1/2 गाजर  1 छोटा चमच्च ग्रीन चिल्ली सॉस  1/2 शिमला मिर्च (हरी)  1 छोटा चमच्च रोस्टेड टोमेटो सॉस  8 प्रॉन , मेरिनेट कर ले  1 बड़ा चमच्च मक्खन  2 बड़े चमच्च तेल , प्रयोग अनुसार  2 लॉन्ग  4 पूरी काली मिर्च  1/2 छोटा चमच्च दाल चीनी पाउडर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च काली मिर्च पाउडर  1 बड़ा चमच्च हरा धनिया , काट ले, गार्निश के लिए नमक , स्वाद अनुसार मेरिनेट के लिए 1/2 छोटा चमच्च लाल मिर्च पाउडर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर नमक , स्वाद अनुसार
